Virtual Assistant – Land Investing Company (Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time)



ABOUT US

Ignacio Land & Investing buys vacant land across Florida, Arizona, Hawaii, Georgia and Tennessee and sells it to home builders and investors. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're looking for a reliable VA to help run day-to-day operations.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Clean and prepare property owner lists (remove duplicates, filter out government/HOA/church owners, format for upload)

- Run skip tracing and prepare files for our texting platform

- Reply to incoming seller text messages using our scripts, tag leads, and pass hot leads to me

- Research lots before offers (comparable sales, lot details, flags like wetlands or slope)

- Follow up with title companies on deals in escrow

- Research builders in our markets and make introductory calls

- Keep our CRM dashboard updated (tasks, leads, deals)

- Send a short weekly report: texts sent, reply rate, leads, deals in progress



TOOLS YOU'LL USE (we'll train you)

PropStream, Land Portal, Smarter Contact, BatchSkipTracing, Google Workspace, DocuSign, our online CRM



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong written/verbal English, professional and friendly with sellers

- Very detail-oriented. You follow a checklist exactly every time

title: Marketing Operations Executor — US Healthcare Company (Remote) — 30-Day Full-Time Build, Then Part-Time
description:
Access Plus Health is a US healthcare compliance company founded by a Harvard-trained, board-certified physician. We are hiring a remote marketing executor for a 30-day full-time build phase, converting to part-time (20–25 hrs/week) once the build is done. This role is execution-focused: the founder sets strategy and provides AI-drafted content; you build, launch, manage, and report. You will work heavily with AI tools — we expect it — but you must be able to operate the platforms yourself, live.



What you will do:



1. Manage paid ads on Meta and Google from provided campaign structure: tracking setup (UTMs, pixel/CAPI), budget management, weekly reporting. Ads launch only after tracking is verified.



2.  Run outbound distribution: LinkedIn engagement and scheduling for the founder's account,
 group participation (Phase 1); webinar promotion and referral partner follow-up sequences (Phase 2)



3. Edit, format, and publish SEO articles from AI-assisted drafts (all content physician-reviewed before publishing) — ongoing cadence of 2/week is Phase 2 scope; Phase 1 focuses on the attribution/sequence/reactivation/ads build



4. Build and manage
 campaigns and automations in GoHighLevel from provided sequence specs (new-lead follow-up, reactivation, newsletter)



5. Maintain CRM hygiene and produce a weekly one-page report: leads, cost per lead,
 metrics, pipeline contribution





Requirements: 

- 5+ years marketing execution for US clients — you have personally run paid campaigns and built marketing automations at real volume, not coordinated a team that did; 

- hands-on GoHighLevel (or HubSpot/ActiveCampaign + fast GHL ramp); 

- personally managed Meta/Google campaigns including tracking; 

- excellent written English; fixed daily overlap hours with US Eastern, with same-day response on urgent items during that window (in writing in the offer).



Compensation — two phases, both stated here. This is a remote, globally-sourced role, and the rate below reflects an international market rate rather than a US-based salary.



Phase 1 (Days 1–30, full-time build): $1,200–$2,000/month based on experience — roughly $7–$12/hour. Default length is 30 days; may finish sooner for a strong performer with no reduction in the month's pay. Extends day-for-day at the full Phase 1 rate only if the delay is caused by APH (review turnaround, account access, portal) — not for candidate pace.



Phase 2 (Day 31 onward): part-time at ~20–25 hrs/week, with pay scaled proportionally from the Phase 1 rate and a small fixed daily overlap with US Eastern hours so urgent items still get a same-day response, both stated in writing.



Bonus: $150–$300/month on qualified-lead targets, carried through both phases and becoming a larger share of total pay once base hours drop.



Day-30 fork (APH's option, not a promise): if performance clearly warrants it, APH may keep this hire full-time at the Phase 1 rate with expanded scope folded in (CRM ownership, proposal support, follow-up sequencing) instead of converting to part-time.



Paid live working session before hire. 



To apply: resume, 2 writing samples, 1 campaign you personally managed (with numbers), and the word "COMPLIANT" first in your application

title: Plan Estimator
description:
Plan Estimator

Natural Elements Painting & Repair (NEPR)



Remote

Full Time, Hourly

Pay: $7.00 - $8.00 per hour

Schedule: Must be available to work Eastern Standard Time, 8am-5pm.



Support Commercial Estimating, Bid Tracking, and Sales Follow-Up

Natural Elements Painting & Repair is hiring a full-time, hourly, Plan Estimator to support our commercial estimating and sales process. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers and documents, and eager to learn construction estimating systems and processes.

The Plan Estimator will help review project plans, prepare and support commercial estimates, organize bid information, assist with proposal development, follow up on submitted estimates, and keep the company’s sales and estimating systems accurate and current.



This is a remote position for someone who can work during Eastern Standard Time business hours, communicate clearly and professionally, and take ownership of assigned tasks while receiving guidance and review from management or a senior estimating team member when needed.



About Natural Elements Painting & Repair

Natural Elements Painting & Repair is a U.S.-based commercial and residential painting, repair, and waterproofing company serving North Central Florida. We are known for delivering reliable service, high-quality work, clear communication, and strong client relationships.

Our team values service, respect, learning, ownership, and health. We are looking for someone who takes pride in accurate work, follows through on commitments, asks good questions, and wants to grow with a team that values accountability and continuous improvement.



Key Responsibilities

Work under the direction of the Senior Plan Estimator.. Begin with smaller, less complex projects and complete work for review before taking on more complex assignments.

Follow the work calendar for bid deadlines, takeoffs, proposals, follow-ups, training, and review meetings. Communicate promptly about questions, conflicts, or deadlines at risk.

Track assigned bids, deadlines, addenda, estimate status, and proposal follow-ups in NEPR’s Estimate Tracking List. Create and organize project folders for assigned bids.

Review plans, specifications, bid forms, and addenda and identify scope of work first before doing takeoffs using the Scope Review Checklist each project.

Prepare Takeoffs and draft estimates, scope notes, exclusions, clarifications, alternates, and proposal information for review

Make estimate revisions based on internal feedback, client updates, addenda, pricing changes, or scope changes

Maintain organized estimate files, plan documents, proposal versions, notes, bid correspondence, and supporting documentation

Follow up on submitted commercial estimates and proposals

Communicate professionally with prospects, clients, general contractors, property managers, builders, vendors, and internal team members

Update Pipedrive and other required systems after client interactions and follow-up activity

Escalate unclear, complex, high-value, or margin-sensitive items to management before proposals are finalized

Participate in estimate reviews, pipeline reviews, sales meetings, and training as assigned

Follow company documentation, communication, cybersecurity, password, device, and confidentiality procedures



Systems and Tools Used

This role will regularly use platforms such as:

ZZ Estimate / Togal AI

Chat GPT

PaintScout

Pipedrive

Google Drive

Google Sheets

Google Calendar

Slack

Connecteam

1Password

BuildingConnected, Procore, or related online bid platforms

 and phone communication systems

Experience with any estimating software and being able to read and understand construction documents is a must. Pipedrive, Google Workspace, or bid platforms are helpful but not required for the right candidate.



What We’re Looking For

Demonstrate understanding of estimating fundamentals, including reviewing project documents, identifying scope, completing takeoffs, and documenting assumptions and exclusions.

Strong critical-thinking skills: able to compare plans, specifications, bid forms, and addenda; notice gaps or conflicts; and ask relevant questions instead of making unsupported assumptions.

Clear, concise, and professional written and spoken English for communicating with GCs, sales representatives, and the internal team; explaining estimate questions; and following up on assigned bids.

Confidence in conducting professional follow-ups and representing NEPR accurately, without making commitments or changing scope without approval.

Ability to research unfamiliar paint, coating, or sealant products using manufacturer specifications and technical data, contact product representatives when needed, and clearly summarize findings for review.

Careful work habits, openness to feedback, and willingness to learn NEPR’s estimating methods, product standards, software, and review process.

Prior estimating, takeoff, painting, construction-document, or construction-product research experience is preferred. Candidates should demonstrate their estimating knowledge through the interview and work sample.

Ability to track follow-ups, bid activity, sales outcomes, and gross margin performance

Willingness to comply with company cybersecurity, password, device, and IT security requirements

Reliable internet service and an updated computer capable of supporting estimating software, online bid platforms, video meetings, and company communication systems



Schedule

Full time, hourly position

Must be available to work during 8am-5pm Eastern Standard Time business hours

All hours worked must be accurately recorded in the company’s approved timekeeping system

Overtime, if applicable, must be approved in advance by management and will be paid in accordance with applicable law



Compensation and Benefits

$7.00 to $8.00 per hour, based on experience and performance

Full-time hourly position

80 hours of PTO (10 full days) and 7 paid US holidays

Opportunity for expanded hours based on performance, workload, business needs, and company growth



Success in This Role Looks Like

Consistently follow NEPR’s Project Scope Review Checklist, avoid repeating previously identified scope omissions, and escalate unclear items.

By around 90 days, can manage routine small-to-medium bids with increasing independence, from tracking and document review through takeoff, draft estimate, proposal preparation, and follow-up. Estimates and proposals remain subject to required review.

Completes assigned work on schedule and keeps bid deadlines, addenda, proposal status, follow-up dates, and next steps current in the Estimate Tracking List and calendar.

Keeps project folders, estimate files, proposal versions, notes, assumptions, and supporting documents organized and easy to review.

Completes assigned proposal follow-ups professionally, records responses or changes, and updates the Plan Estimating Manager.

Communicates missing information, scope conflicts, and pricing or margin questions promptly.

Updates Pipedrive and other company systems as assigned after training.



Why Join Natural Elements Painting & Repair?

Natural Elements Painting & Repair values ownership, problem-solving, learning, respect, and high-quality service. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys detailed work, wants to learn estimating and commercial sales support, and takes pride in helping a team stay organized and responsive.

You will have the opportunity to support real commercial opportunities, learn valuable construction estimating systems, and contribute directly to the growth of a company that values accountability, communication, and continuous improvement.



Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Short-Form Content Clipper / Social Media Growth Editor
description:
Remote | Performance-Based | 30-Day Pilot With Long-Term Opportunity



I’m looking for **1–2 creative short-form content clippers** who understand what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, share, comment, subscribe, and come back for more.



This is **not a traditional video editing position.**



I am a creator, entrepreneur, and strategic leader creating content around personal growth, relationships, motherhood, business, confidence, culture, life experiences, and thought-provoking conversations.



Each week, I will provide original long-form videos, conversations, reflections, and other raw content.



Your job is to find the strongest moments inside that content, turn them into compelling short-form videos, package them for discovery, and publish them on an **assigned company-owned YouTube channel.**



The initial pilot will run for **30 days**, with the opportunity to continue and expand based on performance.



## THE ROLE



You will be assigned a YouTube channel that we own and control.



You will be responsible for helping grow that channel using our original content.



You will **not** be posting to our primary personal social media accounts.



Instead, think of your assigned channel as a discovery channel where you can experiment with content, identify what resonates with audiences, and build an audience around the ideas and conversations within the source material.



During the initial pilot, **YouTube Shorts will be our primary focus.**



There may also be opportunities to distribute content on TikTok, and strong performers may eventually operate across both YouTube and TikTok.







## WHAT YOU’LL DO



Each week, you will receive original source content from me.



You will:



- Review the source material

- Identify the strongest moments without being told exactly what to clip

- Turn those moments into compelling YouTube Shorts

- Determine where each clip should begin and end

- Develop strong hooks and opening frames

- Edit for retention and natural pacing

- Add clean, engaging subtitles

- Write strong YouTube titles and descriptions

- Create covers when appropriate

- Publish consistently to your assigned channel

- Test different hooks, lengths, topics, and editing approaches

- Optimize future content based on actual performance

- Appropriately credit and direct viewers toward our official social media ecosystem

- Monitor views, retention, subscribers, engagement, and other relevant analytics

- Report performance so we can identify what is working



You will have meaningful creative freedom.



I do **not** want someone who needs me to tell them:



*"Clip 2:13–2:47."*



I want someone who can watch a 10-minute conversation and recognize:



**“That is the moment people are going to stop for.”**



## THIS IS A GROWTH ROLE, NOT JUST AN EDITING ROLE



My primary content team already creates intentional content for my official brand channels.



This role serves a different purpose.



Your job is to help me:



**Test ideas.**

**Discover what resonates.**

**Build additional distribution.**

**Grow an audience.**

**Learn from the data.**



I want someone who thinks beyond:



**“Did I edit the video?”**



I want you thinking:



**Why did this Short get 500 views while another received 50,000?**



**Why did people keep watching one video but swipe away from another?**



**Which opening sentences consistently stop people?**



**Which topics generate comments, shares, and subscribers?**



**What did the audience respond to that we should test again?**



**What should I change on the next video based on what the data is telling me?**



If those questions interest you, you may be a strong fit.







## COMPENSATION



IMPORTANT: The salary displayed on this job posting is not representative of guaranteed or expected compensation. OnlineJobs.ph requires a salary figure to publish the listing. This is a performance-based assignment, so actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amount shown depending on the organic performance of your content. The complete compensation structure will be disclosed and agreed upon before you accept the assignment.



This is primarily a **performance-based opportunity.**



Your compensation will be tied to the organic performance of the content you create and distribute.



The initial compensation structure will use a CPM-style model based on qualified organic views after an established minimum performance threshold.



There may also be additional incentives for exceptional performance, audience growth, and breakout content.



Exact compensation rates, eligible views, performance thresholds, measurement periods, payment caps, and reporting requirements will be provided and agreed upon **before the pilot begins.**



The goal is simple:



**The better you become at identifying, packaging, and distributing content people actually want to watch, the greater your earning potential can become.**



Purchased views, subscribers, followers, engagement, bots, engagement groups, paid traffic, or any other artificial method of increasing performance are strictly prohibited.



Only legitimate organic performance will qualify for compensation.



## WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if:



- You genuinely understand YouTube Shorts

- You understand hooks and audience retention

- You can recognize a powerful moment without someone pointing it out

- You understand storytelling and human psychology

- You have excellent English comprehension

- You understand the difference between an interesting statement and a compelling piece of content

- You understand how titles, opening frames, pacing, captions, and packaging affect distribution

- You regularly consume short-form content and understand current editing and storytelling styles

- You are comfortable experimenting

- You pay attention to analytics

- You learn from underperforming content instead of simply posting more of it

- You can work independently

- You are reliable and communicative

- You are comfortable working in a performance-based environment



Experience with TikTok is a plus because the program may eventually expand to both platforms.



You do **not** need to make every video look highly produced.



Sometimes the strongest content is simply:



**A powerful idea + the right opening + clean editing + good packaging.**



Good judgment matters more to me than fancy editing.







## THE CHANNEL



The YouTube channel you work on will be **owned and controlled by me/my company.**



You will receive the appropriate access needed to operate the channel during your assignment.



The channel, audience, content library, subscribers, analytics, and other channel assets remain company property.



If our working relationship ends, your access to the channel will end, but the channel and its content will remain intact.



You will also receive limited permission to use my original footage and likeness solely for work performed as part of this program.







## IMPORTANT CONTENT & BRAND RULES



You may not:



- Change the meaning of something I said

- Create fake quotes

- Intentionally remove context in a way that misrepresents my position

- Use AI to make me appear to say or do something I did not say or do

- Purchase or artificially generate views, subscribers, followers, or engagement

- Upload my source footage to unauthorized accounts

- Use my likeness, voice, or content for unrelated purposes

- Sell, license, distribute, or repurpose my source material outside of this project

- Represent yourself as me

- Represent an assigned clipping channel as my primary personal account



Creative packaging is encouraged.



Misrepresentation is not.







## HOW TO APPLY



Please do **not** send me a long generic cover letter.



I care much more about whether you understand content.



Please send:



1. Your name and location.



2. Tell me about your experience with **YouTube Shorts**.



3. If you also have experience growing TikTok accounts, tell me about that as well.



4. Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, if available.



5. Links to any YouTube channels, TikTok accounts, or social accounts you have helped grow, if available. Please explain what your role was.



6. What editing software do you use?



7. Briefly answer:



**What makes someone stop scrolling and watch a person they have never seen before?**



8. Answer this scenario:



**You post 10 Shorts. One receives 100,000 views. The other nine each receive fewer than 2,000 views. Before creating the next 10 videos, what would you analyze and what would you do differently?**



9. Tell me about one short-form video you have seen recently that you thought was exceptionally well packaged. What made it work?



10. Tell me why a **performance-based clipping role** interests you.



And finally:



**Begin your application with the words “I found the moment.”**



Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed.







## PAID TEST



Final candidates may receive the **same piece of raw content** and be asked to identify and edit the moments they believe have the strongest potential.



The test will be paid.



I am intentionally **not going to tell you which moments to choose.**



I want to see:



**What you notice.**

**What you choose.**

**Where you start the video.**

**How you package it.**

**Why you believe someone will watch it.**



Your editorial judgment matters just as much as your technical editing ability.



## 30-DAY PILOT & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



I am intentionally starting small with only **1–2 clippers.**



The initial engagement will be a 30-day pilot.



During those 30 days, I will evaluate more than total views.



I will be looking at:



- Content quality

- Consistency

- Audience retention

- Subscriber growth

- Engagement

- Ability to identify strong moments

- Ability to learn from analytics

- Communication

- Reliability

- Overall channel growth



If the model works, I intend to expand it.



Strong performers may have opportunities to continue managing their channel, expand into TikTok, operate additional channels, earn increased performance compensation, and take on larger responsibilities as the clipping program grows.



I am looking for people who want to **build something**, not simply complete editing assignments.



If you understand storytelling, audience psychology, YouTube Shorts, and why people share ideas online, I would love to see what you can do.

I currently record approximately 30 professionally filmed short-form videos every two weeks, plus a weekly 1-hour podcast.

Short-Form Content

* Remove dead space and improve pacing

* Publishing the episode to YouTube and podcast platforms

* Social media posts

 posts

title: Experienced Wholesale Real Estate Disposition VA – Buyer Outreach (Long-Term, Remote, Mon–Fri)
description:
JJ Buys Homes | 100% remote | Mon–Fri, 10 AM – 5 PM US Central | $4–$5/hour + commission on every deal



About us



We’re JJ Buys Homes, an established wholesale real estate company with a full acquisitions and dispositions team. We put investment properties under contract and need to find the right cash buyer fast.



Experience is required. You must have done dispositions as a VA for another wholesale company. Please don’t apply if you haven’t worked dispo in wholesaling before.



This is a long-term position, not a short-term gig. We want someone loyal and trustworthy who’s committed to growing with our team for years, not months.



What you’ll be doing



Everyone on your list has bought property for cash recently. They want deal flow. Your job is to find out what kind.



Call cash buyers from a list we build for you, plus follow up by text and

Find out what each buyer buys: areas, price range, cash or hard money, how fast they close, and what condition they’ll take

Send our off-market deals to buyers who fit

Log every call in our CRM, including the no’s and why

Hand warm buyers to our Dispositions Manager the same day



You won’t negotiate or handle contracts. You connect with buyers and get the interested ones to our team.



What we’re looking for



You already know ARV, assignment, comps, wholesaling, and cash buyers

Clear, easy-to-understand English and experience calling US clients. You’ll be trading numbers and addresses with US investors and need to catch details the first time

Experience working in a CRM (Podio is a plus)

Organized, reliable, and good at following up

Reliable internet, a quiet home workspace, and a working headset

Able to work 10 AM – 5 PM US Central, Monday–Friday



Not a fit if



You read a script and mark yes/no. If you can’t tell us after a call what that investor buys and why, the call didn’t count.



We provide



All software, tools, and lists, plus training on our exact process and scripts.



Pay



$4–$5 per hour, plus commission. If you bring us a buyer and we go under contract with that buyer, you get paid on it. No cap.



To apply, please answer:



How long have you done disposition work for wholesalers, and for which companies?

Which CRMs and tools have you used (Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel, skip tracing tools, etc.)?

Walk us through how you’d handle a first call with a cash buyer you’ve never spoken to.

Submit a 30-second video of yourself on camera telling us why we should hire you, plus your resume.



If you do not submit a video, you will not be hired. No exceptions. This is a phone job, and we need to see and hear you before we go further.



SEND YOUR VIDEO HERE OR MESSAGE IT TO ME: 



Start your application with the word “DISPO” so we know you read the full post.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a proactive, confident, and client-focused Collections Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in maintaining healthy client accounts and supporting revenue recovery.

This is more than simply following up on unpaid balances. You’ll work directly with clients to understand billing concerns, resolve account discrepancies, overcome payment obstacles, and find practical solutions that work for both the client and the organization.

The ideal candidate is comfortable having financial conversations, stays composed when handling objections, and takes pride in following through until an issue is fully resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Collections & Revenue Recovery

- Make outbound calls and work assigned collection queues to address unpaid balances and failed payments.

- Prioritize accounts effectively to meet established collection and recovery goals.

- Follow up consistently on outstanding balances and payment commitments.

- Use active listening, professionalism, and persuasive communication to address financial objections.

- Secure appropriate payment commitments and document agreed-upon next steps.



Billing & Account Resolution

- Handle incoming client calls regarding billing questions and invoice disputes.

- Clearly explain charges, invoices, billing cycles, and account balances.

- Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

- Respond promptly to missed calls, messages, and client inquiries.

- Ensure billing concerns are followed through to complete resolution.



Payment Solutions

- Guide clients through customized payment plans and available payment options.

- Assist clients with setting up automatic payments.

- Explain and facilitate available third-party financing solutions.

- Help identify practical payment solutions while maintaining established policies and procedures.



Documentation & CRM Management

- Accurately document client calls,
s, payment commitments, disputes, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain complete and up-to-date account records within assigned CRM and billing systems.

- Track outstanding issues and follow-up requirements to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Maintain a complete record of client interactions and account resolutions.



What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will be organized, persistent, confident on the phone, and comfortable discussing financial matters with clients.

Qualifications include:

- Proven experience in collections, accounts receivable, legal billing, or a related financial role.

- Strong telephone presence and excellent verbal communication skills.

- Excellent active listening and conflict-resolution abilities.

- Ability to handle financial objections and difficult conversations professionally.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- High technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new systems.

- Hands-on experience with legal billing software or CRM systems is highly preferred.

- Ability to independently manage repetitive, detail-oriented workflows.

- Strong follow-through and accountability.

- Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

- A quiet, dedicated home-office setup suitable for handling client calls.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently moving accounts toward resolution while ensuring clients receive clear, respectful, - and professional communication.

You'll be expected to:

- Stay on top of assigned collection queues.

- Follow through consistently on outstanding accounts.

- Resolve billing questions and disputes efficiently.

- Secure and document payment commitments.

- Keep CRM and billing records accurate and complete.

- Ensure clients understand their payment options.

- Close the loop on every outstanding issue.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote



How to Apply

If you have experience in collections, billing, accounts receivable, or legal billing and are confident in communicating with clients about financial matters, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your collections, billing, or accounts receivable experience.

title: We're Hiring! Portrait Photo Editor
description:
**Remote | Freelance | Per-Project | Immediate Start**



**$75 USD per completed photo session**



### Love photography? Have an amazing eye for detail? We might be the perfect fit!



Hi! I'm the owner of **Patti Anne Photography**, a portrait photography business based on the beautiful South Shore of Massachusetts, USA.



I photograph everything from high school seniors and families to newborns, maternity sessions, couples, and more. My photography style is creative, natural, and full of personality, and I'm looking for a talented photo editor to become part of my creative workflow!



I'm looking for someone who can take my images through the first and second rounds of editing, identify the absolute best shots, and prepare everything for me to add my final artistic touches.



**I want someone who can make my life easier, take ownership of their work, and have fun doing it!**



### What You'll Be Doing

- Reviewing portrait photography sessions and selecting the strongest images based on expression, composition, lighting, sharpness, and overall impact.

- Completing first- and second-pass photo edits, including exposure, white balance, color correction, cropping, and consistency.

- Making basic retouching adjustments when needed.

- Flagging standout images that deserve special attention or final creative editing.

- Organizing edited images and maintaining an efficient, consistent workflow.

- Delivering polished, organized work on schedule so I can focus on the final artistic touches.



### Who I'm Looking For



**You might be the perfect fit if you:**

- Have strong experience with Adobe Lightroom and preferably Photoshop.

- Have an excellent eye for portrait photography and natural skin tones.

- Are extremely detail-oriented and notice the little things.

- Can work independently without constant direction or supervision.

- Take deadlines seriously and communicate clearly.

- Have solid technical editing skills and are comfortable learning new workflows.

- Have a positive attitude, take feedback well, and genuinely enjoy creative work.

- Are dependable, organized, and take pride in delivering beautiful results.



**Bonus points** if you've edited professional portrait sessions, especially seniors, families, newborns, or maternity photography.



### Compensation & Schedule



**Pay:** $75 USD per completed photography session.



This is a freelance, project-based position with the potential for ongoing work as we develop a great working relationship.



I'm based in Massachusetts (Eastern Time), and I'd love someone who is available for occasional morning check-ins my time, which generally means evening hours in the Philippines.



You won't need constant supervision or daily meetings. I'm looking for someone who can understand my style, run with it, and deliver great work!



### The Hiring Process



I believe the best way to find a great editor is to see their work!



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small photo-editing test using a sample set of my images. This will help me evaluate your technical skills, attention to detail, consistency, and overall creative eye.



I'll be looking for someone who understands how to enhance a photograph while keeping it natural, beautiful, and true to my style.



### How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your photo-editing experience.

2. Examples of portrait photography you've edited, preferably before-and-after examples.

3. Your experience with Lightroom and Photoshop.

4. Your typical turnaround time for editing a portrait session.

5. Your availability for occasional meetings during Massachusetts morning hours.



**Please include the words "Picture Perfect" in your application subject line** so I know you've read the entire posting!



### Let's Create Something Beautiful!



I'm looking to hire **as soon as possible** and would love to find someone I can build a long-term working relationship with.



I love what I do, and I want to work with someone who brings that same enthusiasm, creativity, and attention to detail to the editing process.



If you're talented, dependable, easy to work with, and love making photographs shine, I'd love to hear from you!



**— Patti**



*Patti Anne Photography | Marshfield, Massachusetts, USA*

title: Inside Sales Associate (ISA)
description:
Company: Eveready Express 



Employment Type: Full-Time 



Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time 



Positions Available: 1 



Department: Sales & Operations 



About Eveready Express 



Eveready Express is a well-established U.S. leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution. Founded in 1984, we have built our reputation on honesty, integrity, mutual respect, and a commitment to delivering reliable logistics solutions. 



Our growing team combines virtual and onsite professionals who work together to provide exceptional service, build lasting customer relationships, and drive business growth. 



We are looking for two results-driven Inside Sales Associates (ISAs) with a strong sales mindset, a hunter mentality, and the ability to build relationships with customers in the fast-paced New York and Tri-State logistics market. 



Position Overview 



The Inside Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business, developing existing customer accounts, and increasing revenue and gross profit across the Eveready Express fleet. 



This role combines proactive outbound sales, customer relationship management, and operational coordination. The ISA will work closely with the Dispatch and Operations teams to identify sales opportunities, secure profitable orders, and maximize fleet utilization. 



The ideal candidate is confident, persuasive, persistent, and comfortable communicating with a wide range of business personalities, particularly in the demanding New York City market. This individual must be able to build rapport quickly, identify customer needs, follow up consistently, and convert opportunities into profitable business. 



Key Responsibilities 



1. New Business Development and Prospecting 



Conduct a minimum of 50 outbound calls per day to identify prospects, qualify leads, introduce Eveready Express services, and develop new business opportunities. 



Proactively contact potential shippers, freight brokers, and other businesses requiring trucking, courier, and logistics services. 



Identify and pursue new sales opportunities through prospect lists, CRM records, inbound inquiries, and leads provided by the Sales team. 



Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects through consistent outreach, follow-ups, and relationship-building activities. 



Develop an effective sales approach for engaging decision-makers and establishing relationships with customers in the New York and Tri-State markets. 



Communicate the company's service capabilities, value proposition, and competitive advantages to prospective customers. 



2. Existing Customer Development and Retention 



Maintain regular contact with active customers to strengthen relationships, understand their logistics needs, and identify opportunities for additional business. 



Re-engage inactive and dormant accounts to generate repeat business and recover lost revenue opportunities. 



Identify opportunities to cross-sell and upsell services based on customer requirements. 



Follow up with prospects who have previously requested quotes or expressed interest in Eveready Express services. 



Maintain a professional, responsive, and customer-focused approach to build long-term business relationships. 



3. Inbound Sales and Order Management 



Respond promptly and professionally to inbound phone calls and
 inquiries from prospective and existing customers. 



Prepare and provide quotes based on customer requirements, service availability, and applicable pricing guidelines. 



Enter customer orders accurately into the company's systems and coordinate with Dispatch to support timely execution. 



Meet a minimum production target of 20 orders per week, while maintaining accuracy, service quality, and profitability. 



Follow up on outstanding quotes and pending orders to improve conversion rates. 



Ensure customer requirements, pricing details, and relevant instructions are documented accurately. 



4. CRM Management and Sales Reporting 



Use OnePageCRM to manage prospect and customer records, track sales opportunities, and maintain an organized follow-up pipeline. 



Log outbound calls,
s, customer conversations, sales activities, and relevant account information in the CRM. 



Utilize approved
 templates and sales tools to maintain consistent and professional communication. 



Keep prospect and customer information accurate, complete, and up to date. 



Track follow-ups, quotes, orders, and other relevant sales performance indicators. 



Maintain disciplined CRM usage to ensure visibility into the sales pipeline and accountability for results. 



5. Dispatch and Operations Coordination 



Work closely with Dispatch and Operations to identify available fleet capacity and convert sales opportunities into executable, profitable orders. 



Communicate customer requirements, delivery details, pricing, and service expectations clearly to the appropriate team members. 



Coordinate with Dispatch to ensure quoted services align with operational capabilities and driver availability. 



Support efforts to improve fleet utilization, revenue generation, and gross profit. 



Escalate customer concerns, service issues, and potential operational challenges to the appropriate team members. 



Contribute to a collaborative work environment focused on customer satisfaction, profitability, and operational efficiency.

title: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist – U.S. Wholesaling (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment and wholesaling company looking for motivated, confident, and competitive Acquisition Representatives to join our team long-term.



Our acquisition model is primarily **agent-based**. Instead of spending your day cold calling homeowners, you will communicate with U.S. real estate agents to identify investment opportunities, build relationships, submit offers, negotiate deals, and get properties under contract.



This is a **sales and negotiation role**, not a traditional virtual assistant position.



### What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility is to generate contracts through relationships and conversations with real estate agents.



You will:



- Call and communicate with U.S. real estate agents

- Build relationships with agents and become a reliable investor contact

- Identify potential investment opportunities

- Discuss properties, pricing, seller situations, and offer terms

- Make and follow up on offers

- Negotiate pricing and terms

- Handle objections and counteroffers professionally

- Consistently follow up with agents and previously submitted offers

- Maintain an organized pipeline in our CRM

- Work with our team to evaluate opportunities and determine appropriate offer prices

- Move qualified opportunities toward signed contracts

- Meet activity and performance KPIs



You will have support from the rest of our team for property analysis, transaction coordination, and disposition of contracted properties. We are not expecting you to do everything yourself.



### Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who can **sell**.



The ideal candidate is:



- Fluent or highly proficient in spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with American real estate professionals

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

- Professional and personable on the phone

- Strong at building relationships

- Comfortable negotiating and asking direct questions

- Persistent with follow-up

- Able to handle rejection without losing motivation

- Competitive and motivated by results

- Organized and capable of managing a pipeline

- Coachable and willing to follow an established process

- Reliable and consistent

- Interested in a long-term opportunity with significant earning potential



Previous experience in U.S. real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, agent outreach, cold calling, appointment setting, or phone sales is strongly preferred.



However, we care more about your **communication skills, sales ability, confidence, work ethic, and willingness to learn** than having the perfect resume.



### Compensation



This is a **commission-only position. There is no guaranteed salary or hourly wage.**



Acquisition Representatives earn **10% commission on deals they acquire that successfully close and generate revenue for the company.**



There is **no cap on earnings**. Your compensation is directly tied to your performance.



For example:



- $10,000 closed deal = $1,000 commission

- $20,000 closed deal = $2,000 commission

- $30,000 closed deal = $3,000 commission

- $50,000 closed deal = $5,000 commission



Commission is paid on qualifying deals after the transaction successfully closes and the company receives the funds. Full commission terms will be explained before starting.



This structure is designed for someone who wants substantially more upside than a traditional VA salary and is confident in their ability to produce results.



### What We Provide



You will be joining an existing real estate operation, not building a process from scratch.



We provide:



- CRM and established acquisition systems

- Training on our acquisition process

- Property analysis and comping support

- Offer guidance

- Transaction coordination

- Disposition/buyer support

- Team communication and ongoing coaching



Your job is to become excellent at the front end of the business: **talking to agents, finding opportunities, following up, negotiating, and getting contracts signed.**



### Schedule



Because we primarily communicate with U.S.-based real estate agents, you must be available during U.S. business hours.



We are looking for people who can consistently dedicate meaningful time to the role and want to build a long-term position within the company.



### Growth Opportunity



We are actively growing our real estate operation and entering additional U.S. markets.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on more responsibility as the company grows. We want to develop people who can consistently generate deals and eventually become key members of our acquisitions team.



If you are looking for a comfortable position where you simply complete assigned tasks and collect a guaranteed paycheck, this probably isn't the right opportunity.



If you are competitive, confident on the phone, motivated by commission, and want your income to increase based on your results, we want to hear from you.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A description of your sales experience.

3. Any experience you have with U.S. real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, real estate agents, cold calling, or phone sales.

4. A **voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful in this role.

5. Your availability and the U.S. hours you are able to work.



At the end of your application, include the word **“CLOSER”** so we know you read the entire posting.



Please do not apply if you are only interested in salaried or hourly positions. This opportunity is **commission-only with uncapped performance-based earning potential.**

title: Hiring: Senior Voice and Chat AI Engineer
description:
Important Notice to Applicants:



Please note that we are only contacting and communicating with candidates through OnlineJobsPH. Any applications or direct contact made outside of these channels, including emails, social media messages, direct messages to our CEO, or messages sent to our general company email, will not be considered and will be automatically declined.



About the Company:



We are a private U.S.-based company operating across multiple departments that support legal, staffing, and client-service operations. Our teams collaborate in dynamic, fast-paced environments focused on innovation, integrity, and client success.



In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, making a real impact in operational, legal, and client-focused projects—all from the comfort of your home. Details about our company structure and associated teams will be introduced during the interview process



About the Role 



We're building a multi-tenant AI receptionist and case intake platform for law firms. It answers inbound calls over SIP, whether they originate on the PSTN or from the firm's own SIP infrastructure. Each call loads that firm's tenant config and runs the right intake workflow, collecting and confirming structured case details. It applies the firm's qualification and routing rules without giving legal advice. From there it books consultations, warm-transfers to staff, or creates follow-up tasks. Intake records, transcripts, summaries, and recordings go to firm staff through controlled access. 



We are looking for a highly autonomous Senior Voice AI Engineer to build this from the ground up and deliver a pilot-ready MVP within 90 days. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role: you will own architecture, technology decisions, implementation, deployment, testing, and technical operation, working directly with stakeholders who provide product direction, domain input, and rapid feedback rather than a detailed specification. The MVP channel is inbound voice with no outbound dialing, but design the conversation and workflow layer so web chat and other text-based channels can reuse the same tenant rules, integrations, and guardrails. This is applied product engineering, not AI research. 



What You Will Own 



Voice and Conversation Engineering 



Build and optimize the real-time voice pipeline — LiveKit Agents, Strands, or another well-justified architecture — with streaming STT, LLM, and TTS or speech-to-speech models, tuned for perceived latency, transcription accuracy, and naturalness. 



Implement voice activity detection, endpointing, turn-taking, barge-in, interruption recovery, silence handling, and conversation repair for noisy lines, accents, incomplete answers, long pauses, and caller corrections. 



Build deterministic workflow and state management — reliable tool calling, validation, retries, timeouts, idempotency, failure recovery — so critical intake actions never depend on prompt behavior alone. 



Telephony:



- Configure inbound numbers, SIP trunks, dispatch rules, call routing, DTMF, and human transfers with providers such as LiveKit, Twilio, Telnyx, or Bandwidth. 



- Handle dropped calls, provider failures, after-hours routing, duplicate calls, spam, and wrong numbers, with monitoring for call quality, transfer success, and provider performance. 



- Multi-Tenant Product Architecture 



- Design secure tenant isolation across data, prompts, workflows, integrations, credentials, recordings, and reporting. 



- Build a reusable configuration model — practice areas, questions, qualification criteria, disclosures, transfer destinations, calendars, languages, business rules — versioned so production behavior can be reproduced and audited, and so scaling from pilot to many firms is configuration rather than custom implementation. 



Integrations and Data:



- Build APIs and webhooks for calendars, CRMs, and legal case-management platforms such as Clio, Filevine, Lawmatics, Litify, or MyCase, with queues, retries, reconciliation, and audit trails. 



- Convert conversations into validated, structured intake records and safely store call metadata, transcripts, summaries, recordings, tool activity, and outcomes. 



Safety, Security, and Reliability:



- Implement guardrails against legal advice, promised outcomes, an implied attorney-client relationship, or operation outside approved workflows, existing clients, sensitive matters, unsupported practice areas, and callers who need a human. 



- Build configurable disclosures and recording controls per firm and jurisdiction; protect caller data through encryption, least-privilege access, secret management, retention controls, audit logging, and review of model and vendor data-handling policies; and run production monitoring, alerting, tracing, and i
 response. 



Testing and Evaluation:



Build automated conversation tests and regression suites covering interruptions, silence, noisy audio, accents, ambiguous or invalid answers, provider failures, and unexpected caller behavior. 



Set measurable standards for intake completeness, field accuracy, tool-call and transfer success, latency, safety violations, and cost per call; review real calls to improve prompts, workflow logic, models, and provider selection; and keep a repeatable process for safely deploying changes. 



Required Experience:



5+ years of professional software engineering — the scope and quality of what you have shipped matters more than the number. 



Hands-on experience building and launching at least one real-time, phone-based voice AI agent in production or a serious customer pilot. Demos alone are not sufficient. 



Strong Python: asynchronous programming, streaming systems, API development, and production debugging. 



LiveKit Agents or a comparable real-time voice framework (Pipecat, Vapi, Retell, or a custom WebRTC/WebSocket implementation), integrating STT, LLM, TTS, or speech-to-speech models from multiple providers. 



Practical telephony experience — SIP, PSTN providers, call routing, DTMF, transfers, codecs — with deep understanding of latency, voice activity detection, endpointing, turn-taking, barge-in, and streaming tool execution. 



Dependable agent workflows with explicit state, structured outputs, and deterministic business rules; multi-tenant SaaS with strong data isolation; cloud deployment and operations (containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring); and clear communication of technical tradeoffs to a non-specialist. 



Preferred Experience:



Production LiveKit (Agents, Cloud, or self-hosted), Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or Nova Sonic. 



OpenAI Realtime, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, or similar providers. 



Web chat or omnichannel conversational systems, multilingual voice, and legal technology, healthcare, financial services, or another privacy-sensitive industry. 



A computer science degree is not required; demonstrated production work, technical judgment, and ownership matter more. 



What Success Looks Like 



Within 90 days, pilot law firms can route inbound calls to a production voice agent that: 



Conducts a natural, professional intake conversation and accurately captures the information the firm needs. 



Follows tenant-specific rules and disclosures, completes approved actions reliably, transfers callers to a human when appropriate, and avoids legal advice and unsupported claims. 



Produces useful structured records and summaries, can be monitored, evaluated, debugged, and improved, and supports additional firms primarily through configuration rather than custom development.



How to Apply



Please send your application ONLY to 



Make sure your subject line begins with:



“Sr. Ai Voice and Chat Engineer – [Your Name]”



This helps us correctly identify your application and confirms that you’ve read the full job description carefully.

title: Ecommerce VA Partnership Opportunity – Shopify Referrals
description:
Shopify Merchant Referral Partner – For Experienced VAs



About JST Fulfill



JST Fulfill is a China-based sourcing and order fulfillment company. We support ecommerce businesses with product sourcing, quality control, order fulfillment and one-piece dropshipping.



Website:





About This Opportunity



This is a flexible referral partnership for Virtual Assistants and ecommerce professionals who currently work, or have previously worked, directly with established Shopify or DTC merchants.



This is not a traditional VA position, a cold-outreach role or a lead-list-building job.



We understand that an experienced VA may only know a limited number of suitable Shopify merchants. You are not expected to provide new merchants every week or every month.



If a Shopify merchant you legitimately know has a genuine need for China sourcing, QC, fulfillment or one-piece dropshipping, you may introduce the merchant to JST Fulfill and earn fixed rewards based on the introduction and the merchant’s subsequent eligible-order milestones.



Even if you only know one or two suitable merchants, you may still participate.



There are no fixed working hours, no monthly referral quota and no requirement to leave your current job.



Who This Is For



This opportunity may be suitable for:



• Shopify Virtual Assistants

• Ecommerce Operations VAs

• Shopify Store Managers

• Customer Support or Order Management VAs

• Ecommerce Account Managers

• Product Listing or Product Research VAs

• Ecommerce Project Managers

• VA agency team members

• Freelancers who have worked directly with established Shopify merchants



Previous work under the exact title “Virtual Assistant” is not required. However, you should have genuine experience working directly with Shopify or DTC businesses and should be able to communicate legitimately with a store owner or another relevant decision-maker.



How It Works



1. Review JST Fulfill’s services and referral requirements.



2. When a Shopify merchant you legitimately know has a genuine sourcing, QC, fulfillment or dropshipping need, ask whether the merchant is willing to speak with JST.



3. Obtain the merchant’s permission before making the introduction.



4. Bring the merchant and JST into the same conversation.



You may:



• Create a WhatsApp group.

• Make a shared
 introduction.

• Open a LinkedIn conversation.

• Arrange an online meeting.

• Use another appropriate communication method.



The merchant does not need to contact JST independently. You may create the introduction and bring both parties together.



5. Provide a short summary of the merchant’s business and confirmed requirements.



6. JST will handle product details, quotations, pricing, shipping discussions, service terms, negotiations and closing.



You are not required to close the sale.



Referral Rewards



Each accepted merchant is registered and tracked separately.



For each attributed merchant, you can earn:



• USD 30 when JST verifies and accepts the Qualified Referral.

• An additional USD 40 when the merchant completes 50 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 80 when the merchant completes 500 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 150 when the merchant completes 1,000 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 300 when the merchant completes 2,000 Eligible Orders through JST.



Total potential rewards for one merchant reaching 2,000 Eligible Orders:



USD 600



The rewards are cumulative. Each milestone reward is paid once for each attributed merchant.



There is no fixed working schedule, no minimum number of referrals and no requirement to provide new merchants every month.



Verified rewards are paid through Wise or PayPal.



What Counts as a Qualified Referral



A referral will count as a Qualified Referral only when all of the following conditions are satisfied:



1. The merchant operates an active Shopify or DTC store.

2. The merchant already receives genuine customer orders.

3. You are communicating with the store owner, founder, ecommerce manager, operations manager or another relevant decision-maker.

4. The merchant has a current and specific sourcing, QC, fulfillment or one-piece dropshipping need.

5. The merchant provides enough information for JST to continue the discussion, such as a store link, product link, image, specification, destination market or a clear description of the current problem.

6. The merchant agrees to communicate directly with JST.

7. You bring the merchant and JST into the same WhatsApp,
, LinkedIn, meeting or other approved conversation.

8. The merchant is not an existing JST customer, existing active JST lead or duplicate referral.



JST will confirm in writing whether the referral has been accepted and registered under your name.



The USD 30 Qualified Referral reward will be paid only after the referral has been reviewed and accepted by JST.



What Does Not Count



The following do not count as Qualified Referrals:



• Lists of Shopify stores.

• Scraped or purchased contacts.

• Contact details without an active conversation.

• Generic replies without a confirmed business need.

• Someone who is not a decision-maker.

• A merchant introduced without their permission.

• A store without genuine customer orders.

• Samples, personal orders, self-orders or artificial test orders.

• Cancelled or refunded orders.

• An existing JST customer, existing active lead or duplicate referral.

• A fabricated merchant, conversation, requirement or screenshot.



Eligible Order Definition



An Eligible Order is a genuine end-customer order submitted by the attributed merchant to JST, processed through JST and included in JST’s verified settlement records.



The following do not count as Eligible Orders:



• Test orders

• Sample orders

• Personal orders

• Self-orders

• Cancelled orders

• Refunded orders

• Fraudulent orders

• Orders placed before the merchant was registered under the referral partner



The 50-order, 500-order, 1,000-order and 2,000-order milestones are calculated separately for each attributed merchant.



Professional and Privacy Rules



• Obtain the merchant’s permission before making an introduction.

• Do not share confidential client lists, customer data, order data, passwords, store access or private business information.

• Do not contact a current or previous employer’s clients if you are not authorized to do so.

• Follow any employment, confidentiality or non-solicitation agreements that apply to you.

• Do not promise specific prices, discounts, shipping times, availability or business results on JST’s behalf.

• Do not misrepresent your relationship with the merchant or with JST.

• Do not pressure a merchant who has no genuine current need.

• Where required by your agreement or professional obligations, disclose that you may receive a referral reward.



Your professional relationship and reputation are important. Only recommend JST when the merchant has a genuine and relevant need.



Tracking and Transparency



When JST accepts a Qualified Referral:



• JST will confirm the attribution in writing.

• The merchant will be registered under your referral record.

• JST will track the merchant’s Eligible Orders.

• JST will notify you when a reward milestone is verified.

• Verified rewards will be paid according to the written referral terms.



Customer-level confidential order details may be withheld, but JST will provide sufficient information to confirm the applicable milestone and reward.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the code:



JST-REFERRAL-26



Please provide:



1. Your resume, professional profile or OnlineJobs.ph profile.



2. Brief answers to the following questions:



• What Shopify or ecommerce work are you currently doing, or what relevant work have you done during the past two years?

• What tasks did you perform directly for Shopify merchants?

• Did you communicate directly with the store owner, founder, ecommerce manager or operations manager?

• Approximately how many Shopify merchants could you legitimately contact if a relevant need arises? A reasonable range is acceptable.

• Why would these merchants recognize or trust you?



Do not provide client names, private contact information or confidential business information in your initial application.



Selection Process



JST will review your application and relevant Shopify experience.



Suitable applicants will receive the written referral terms and a short introduction to JST’s services.



After accepting the terms, you may begin making referrals whenever a legitimate opportunity arises.



There is no application fee, unpaid trial, deposit, training fee or software fee.



Your first accepted Qualified Referral will be paid according to the normal reward structure.



This is a flexible, results-based referral partnership. It is not a guaranteed monthly salary position.

title: AI Video Automation Expert: Build a Hands-Off Pipeline for Music Performance Reels ($1,000 fixed)
description:
About the project

I run
 and Instagram pages posting short, photorealistic AI videos of a recurring character, an older female country singer, performing original songs live in a concert arena, with emotional crowd reactions. Vertical 9:16, about 15 seconds, posted as Reels.



I want a system that produces these videos on autopilot, ready to post, music included. Today I do everything by hand in Dreamina, and the results are inconsistent: lip-sync drifts, crowds freeze, things look unnatural.



Reference: this is the quality bar (ideally even better)



Example page: 

Example reel: 



Study these before applying. If your samples don’t come close to this level, please don’t apply.



Music is the product

Genre: emotional country / Americana ballads (optionally gospel or folk), with a raw, believable vocal for an older female singer. Not a polished pop voice.

Structure: hook-first. The strongest, most emotional line lands in the first 3 seconds, and the 15-second clip builds to a peak.

Lyrics: original, simple, heartfelt themes (family, loss, aging, faith, love, never giving up). Must feel human, not AI clichés.

Consistency: the same recognizable “artist voice” across songs, so the page feels like one real singer.

Sync: the singer’s mouth, breathing and emotion match the vocal exactly, and cuts land on the beat or phrase changes.



What you’ll build



Song generation: original lyrics and music (e.g. Suno, Udio or ElevenLabs Music, via API or automation), cut to the best 15-second hook.

Character consistency: the same singer every time (face, hair, look) from a reference image or trained character.

Shot planning: 4–6 shots timed to the song’s phrases (singer close-ups, wide shots, crowd reactions).

Video generation: via API (e.g. Seedance, Kling, Veo or Runway, through fal.ai, Replicate or direct). Realistic lip-sync and a living, moving crowd are top priority.

Automatic QC: reject and re-roll bad takes (frozen backgrounds, lip-sync failures, distorted hands or faces).

Assembly: cuts on the beat, the original song as the soundtrack, 1080p export.

Output: finished videos plus captions and hashtags delivered to a Google Drive folder (bonus: auto-scheduling to

Must have



Proven experience with AI video and AI music generation, and automation. Show me videos you’ve produced and pipelines you’ve built.

title: Short Form Video Editor / Social Media Manager
description:
Part-Time Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Manager



I’m looking for a talented part-time video editor/social media manager to help me build a new personal content platform across Instagram, TikTok and potentially YouTube Shorts.



The content



The account will explore a broad question: What does it mean to build an authentic life? 



The content will combine personal storytelling with ideas around ambition, success, money, identity, emotional self-awareness, relationships, risk and what makes a satisfying life.



My own story provides some of the backdrop: I experienced homelessness and lost my parents young, before eventually studying at Cambridge, becoming a lawyer and achieving financial success relatively early in life.



This is NOT intended to be motivational “rags to riches” content or a page offering simplistic life advice. The aim is thoughtful, honest and psychologically interesting content — packaged in a way that is genuinely engaging on short-form platforms.



 What I need



I will primarily handle the ideas, scripts and filming. I’m looking for someone who can take that raw material and turn it into polished, high-performing short-form content.



You would help with:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Creating strong pacing, cuts, captions and on-screen text

- Helping optimise hooks and video structure for retention

- Selecting music/B-roll where appropriate without over-editing

- Posting and scheduling content consistently

- Writing/optimising captions and post copy

- Monitoring analytics, retention and engagement

- Identifying what is and isn't working and helping iterate the format

- Keeping up with relevant short-form trends and platform conventions

- Potentially helping develop content ideas as we learn what resonates



The style



I’m looking for something clean, intelligent and understated.



Think strong hooks and excellent retention, but not hyperactive editing, constant sound effects or generic motivational-content aesthetics. The editing should support the story rather than become the story.



A good editor for this project will understand that thoughtful content can still be highly engaging.



Who I'm looking for



Ideally, you:



Have experience editing talking-head/personal-brand short-form content



Understand retention, hooks and storytelling — not just video-editing software



Have a strong instinct for what works on Instagram and TikTok



Can preserve a natural speaking voice rather than making everything feel overly manufactured



Have good visual taste and attention to typography, captions and pacing



Are comfortable giving honest creative feedback



Can work independently and reliably



Are interested in helping build an account from the beginning and improving the format through experimentation and analytics



Experience growing a creator/personal-brand account would be a significant plus.



Commitment



This will initially be a part-time freelance role, with the potential to grow if the account gains traction.



I'm more interested in finding the right person than prescribing an exact number of hours. We can agree a workflow and output that makes sense based on your availability and editing process.

title: Transportation Customer Service
description:
Department: Customer Service / Transportation Operations

Position: Customer Service Representative – Phone Support

Industry: Freight Transportation, LTL & Logistics

Employment Type: Full-Time



Position Summary



Trinity Transport Systems is seeking a professional, organized, and customer-focused Transportation Customer Service Representative to manage incoming and outgoing phone calls, assist customers with shipment inquiries, coordinate with dispatch, and provide accurate updates on freight pickups and deliveries.



The ideal candidate must have excellent communication skills, the ability to multitask in a fast-paced transportation environment, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.



This position serves as a key communication link between customers, dispatchers, warehouse personnel, and drivers.



Key Responsibilities



1. Customer Service & Phone Communication



Answer incoming customer calls promptly and professionally.



Assist customers with shipment status, pickup requests, delivery schedules, and general transportation questions.



Make outgoing calls to confirm appointments, coordinate deliveries, and provide shipment updates.



Respond to customer complaints and concerns calmly and professionally.



Maintain a positive attitude, even when handling difficult customers or urgent situations.



Document important customer conversations and follow-up requests.



2. Shipment Tracking & Updates



Monitor shipments from pickup through final delivery.



Provide customers with accurate estimated delivery dates and shipment status updates.



Communicate shipment delays, missed pickups, and delivery exceptions.



Coordinate with dispatch and drivers to obtain shipment information.



Follow up on shipments requiring appointments or special delivery instructions.



Confirm successful deliveries and assist with proof of delivery (POD) requests.



3. Dispatch & Operations Support



Communicate daily with dispatchers, drivers, and warehouse staff.



Assist with scheduling freight pickups and deliveries.



Notify dispatch of customer requests, changes, or service issues.



Help resolve delivery challenges, including incorrect addresses, missed appointments, and refused shipments.



Ensure special customer instructions are properly communicated.



Escalate urgent operational problems to management when necessary.



4. Customer Relations & Problem Resolution



Build and maintain strong professional relationships with customers.



Take ownership of customer inquiries until they are resolved or properly transferred.



Follow up on unresolved service issues.



Communicate clearly when transportation delays or unexpected situations occur.



Work with management to identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction.



Help protect customer relationships through proactive communication.



5. Documentation & Administrative Duties



Enter accurate shipment notes into the transportation management system (TMS).



Maintain records of customer calls,
s, and shipment updates.



Assist with bills of lading (BOLs), proof of delivery documents, and shipment paperwork.



Verify pickup and delivery information.



Support daily customer service reporting when required.



Qualifications & Requirements



Previous customer service or phone support experience preferred.



Transportation, trucking, freight brokerage, or LTL experience is a plus.



Strong verbal and written communication skills.



Comfortable handling a high volume of incoming and outgoing calls.



Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Outlook and Excel.



Ability to multitask and prioritize urgent requests.



Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.



Professional telephone etiquette.



Ability to work independently and as part of a team.



Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.



Performance Expectations



The Customer Service Representative will be evaluated on:



Phone Responsiveness: Answer calls promptly and minimize missed customer calls.



Communication Accuracy: Provide clear and accurate shipment information.



Customer Satisfaction: Maintain professional and positive customer relationships.



Follow-Up: Ensure customer inquiries and service issues receive timely attention.



Documentation: Keep accurate records of calls, shipment notes, and service exceptions.



Teamwork: Maintain effective communication with dispatch, warehouse personnel, and drivers.



Problem Resolution: Demonstrate ownership and initiative when addressing customer concerns.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who understands that transportation customer service is more than simply answering the phone.



The right person takes ownership of customer concerns, follows through on commitments, communicates before problems escalate, and understands the importance of keeping freight moving.



Our Goal: Every customer should feel confident that Trinity Transport Systems is actively managing their shipments and that someone is available to provide answers, assistance, and solutions.



Reporting Structure



Reports To: Customer Service Manager / Operations Manager



Works Closely With: Dispatch, Warehouse Operations, Drivers, Sales, and Management.
