title: E-Commerce Operations Manager (AI-First)
description:
Remote · Full-Time · Start within the next two weeks



Proudchapter makes personalized children's books: parents upload a photo, and their child becomes the hero of a beautifully illustrated story that we print and ship. We sell every day in the US through our own Shopify store and Meta ads, and we are now expanding into the UK and Europe. Proudchapter is part of Pet Printed, an international DTC e-commerce company.



We're looking for an E-Commerce Manager who takes real ownership of the store's day-to-day operations and is excellent at execution. You'll work closely with our project lead: some areas are yours to run, and on top of that you'll get a steady stream of tasks that you implement quickly and to a high standard. Where you see something that could work better, you propose it and, once agreed, you build it.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

• The store day to day: Shopify products, prices, shipping, checkout and markets stay correct and up to date

• Orders: checking orders, handling issues, cancellations and customer
s

• Launches: new books, products and upsells go live on time and without errors

• Ads operations: new ads and ad sets are uploaded in Meta with clean naming and tracking

• New markets: pages, prices and checks for the UK and European countries before they launch



WHAT YOU'LL IMPLEMENT

• Product pages, offers and landing pages, from brief to live

• Upsells and bundles (posters, hardcover, dedication pages and more)

• A/B tests on pages and offers, with a short report of what won

• Coordination with our print partners on SKUs, specs, prices and test orders

• Improvements you propose yourself, once we've agreed on them



You'll get clear tasks and priorities. What we expect is that you turn them into finished, high-quality work, spot problems before they reach a customer, and say early when something is unclear or blocked. You keep your work organized in Asana and give clear, short status updates.



AI-FIRST

AI is a core part of how we work. We use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, MCP connectors and AI automations every day, together with Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, GitHub, Vercel, GA4, Asana and Slack.

You should already use AI tools to research faster, build faster and automate repetitive work, and be comfortable using Claude Code to make changes, test them and share a preview.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Hands-on experience in DTC or e-commerce, ideally with Shopify

• A strong understanding of product pages, funnels, offers, conversion and order value

• A good general understanding of Meta ads

• You take responsibility: what's yours runs, and tasks you take on get finished, on time and done properly

• High standards and attention to detail: prices, orders and launches have to be right

• Highly proficient with modern AI tools

• You learn new tools quickly and solve technical problems on your own

• You think along and suggest better ways of doing things

• Fluent written and spoken English. Another European language (German, Italian, Spanish, a Nordic language) is a plus

• Clear, proactive communication



We care more about what you've done and how fast you learn than about years on your CV.



HOW WE WORK

We move fast, test often and keep the team small.

Communication is part of the job: you answer on Slack during your working hours, you say early when something is late or unclear, and you overlap at least 4 hours a day with Central European Time.

As you show the quality of your work, you'll take on more responsibility and bigger projects. There is a lot of room for this role to grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words:

"I'M ALL IN FOR PROUDCHAPTER"

Applications that don't start with these words will not be considered.



Then send us ONE short Loom video (5 minutes maximum) that answers these three questions:

1. YOUR PROUDEST PROJECT

Show us a store, product page or landing page you built or were responsible for. Walk us through it: what was your part, what works well, what you would still improve, and what the result was. Please include the link.



2. YOUR AI WORKFLOW

Show us one workflow where you used AI to build or automate something in e-commerce. What did it do, and how much time did it save?



3. YOUR FIRST THREE CHANGES

Open one of our product pages on 
. Which three things would you change first to sell more or raise the order value, and why?

Below the Loom link, please add:

• Your expected monthly compensation for a full-time role

• When you can start

• Your time zone and working hours



HIRING PROCESS



Application with Loom → Short interview (15 minutes) → Paid test project → Final call

Everyone who reaches the test gets the same paid task: build a product page from our mockups using Claude Code, push it to GitHub, deploy it on Vercel and send us the preview link.

We review applications as they come in and aim to make a decision within about a week.

title: Senior Amazon Brand Manager — AI, Automation & Growth
description:
bout Prodigy Media



Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience launching, managing, and growing private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA.



We manage a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple categories and are actively transforming our operations through AI, automation, and smarter business systems.



We're looking for a highly capable Senior Amazon Brand Manager who combines deep Amazon experience, strong leadership, analytical thinking, and hands-on AI development skills.



This is not a position for someone who simply monitors performance, generates reports, or follows instructions.



We're looking for a problem solver, builder, and leader who takes ownership of brand growth, drives execution, and finds better ways to run our business.



Core Responsibilities



1. Brand Ownership, Growth & Problem Solving

Take responsibility for the performance and continued growth of assigned Amazon brands.

Monitor revenue, profitability, conversion rates, traffic, organic rankings, advertising performance, and competitive positioning.

Analyze business data to identify declining performance, missed opportunities, and operational inefficiencies.

Investigate problems to determine their underlying causes rather than relying on surface-level metrics.



Develop, implement, and execute solutions to identified problems.

Take ownership of improvements and measure results to determine whether the solution worked.

Develop strategies to increase sales, improve conversion rates, strengthen listings, and maximize profitability.

Prioritize initiatives based on their impact on revenue, efficiency, and brand growth.

Identifying a problem is only the first step.

For example, if a product's sales decline, we expect you to investigate the cause, develop a corrective strategy, coordinate the necessary team members, implement the changes, and evaluate the results.

We value people who solve problems, not just report them.



2. AI Development, Claude, Codex & Automation — CRITICAL REQUIREMENT

AI capabilities are a major requirement for this position.

You must have practical experience using Claude, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex to develop solutions, build tools, and automate business processes.

We're not looking for someone who only uses AI for writing, brainstorming, or generating reports.

We want someone who can use AI to BUILD, CREATE, DEVELOP, AUTOMATE, AND EXECUTE.



Responsibilities include:

Use Claude Code and Codex to build, modify, and improve internal business tools, applications, and workflows.

Identify repetitive processes, operational bottlenecks, and inefficiencies across the company.

Independently research, design, and implement technical solutions that improve productivity.

Develop AI-powered applications to simplify complex workflows and eliminate unnecessary manual work.

Build automations for Amazon reporting, competitor analysis, performance monitoring, project coordination, and operational processes.

Integrate AI tools with existing platforms, APIs, databases, and project management systems.

Test, troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve the solutions you develop.

Proactively invest time in learning and developing new AI capabilities that can benefit the company.

You don't need to be a professional software engineer, but you must be comfortable using AI coding agents to build functional applications and automations.



Our expectation: When you encounter a recurring operational problem, you should be capable of evaluating whether an automation, AI workflow, or custom-built application can solve it permanently.



We value initiative and experimentation. We want someone willing to invest time in creating systems that make the entire company more efficient.



3. Team Leadership, Project Management & Execution

You'll work closely with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and other departments to ensure brand priorities are executed effectively.



Responsibilities include:

Coordinate directly with PPC specialists and graphic designers to establish priorities.

Assign projects, clearly define expectations, and establish realistic deadlines.

Manage creative production priorities, including listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stores, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Ensure PPC strategies and creative initiatives support the same brand growth objectives.

Track assignments, follow up on deliverables, and maintain accountability for project completion.

Identify stalled projects, missed deadlines, and resource constraints before they become significant problems.

Review deliverables for quality, brand consistency, and alignment with performance objectives.

Improve communication, collaboration, and workflow efficiency across departments.

Use project management tools and automations to make priorities, ownership, and deadlines visible.

We need someone who leads execution rather than simply passing tasks between departments.

You must be comfortable making decisions, assigning responsibilities, establishing timelines, and ensuring work is completed.



4. Amazon Product Launches — REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

You must have direct experience successfully launching private-label products on Amazon.

Conduct competitive research, market analysis, and keyword research.

Develop comprehensive launch strategies and execution timelines.

Coordinate creative assets, listing development, A+ Content, product videos, and launch readiness.

Work with PPC specialists to establish advertising strategies, launch budgets, and campaign priorities.

Develop compliant strategies for generating initial product awareness and reviews.

Coordinate inventory availability and operational launch requirements.

Track launch performance, identify challenges, and implement improvements.

Manage post-launch optimization to improve rankings, conversions, sales velocity, and profitability.



We're looking for someone who understands the complete Amazon product launch process and can coordinate a successful launch from preparation through ongoing growth.



5. External Marketing & Brand Expansion

Although Amazon is our primary sales channel, we're expanding our external marketing capabilities.

You should have practical experience or a strong working understanding of:

Meta advertising 
 and Instagram).

TikTok marketing and short-form video.

Influencer marketing, affiliate partnerships, and UGC campaigns.

External traffic strategies that support Amazon sales.

Shopify, landing pages, and customer acquisition funnels.

 marketing and brand-building initiatives.



You must understand how to coordinate external marketing initiatives that build awareness, attract customers, and generate measurable sales.



You don't need to be a specialist in every channel, but you must understand how these channels work and how to evaluate their performance.



Minimum Qualifications

Required:

Minimum 4 years of hands-on Amazon brand management experience.

Proven experience managing and growing private-label brands on Amazon USA.

Strong knowledge of Seller Central, SEO, listing optimization, Amazon analytics, and advertising performance.

Direct experience planning and executing Amazon product launches.

Strong analytical abilities with demonstrated experience solving business performance problems.

Practical experience with Claude, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex.

Ability to build working AI applications, automations, or internal business tools.

Experience coordinating PPC specialists, graphic designers, and cross-functional projects.

Ability to assign priorities, establish deadlines, and ensure timely execution.

Understanding of external marketing and customer acquisition.

Strong communication, organizational, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate independently and take full ownership of responsibilities.



Preferred:

Experience managing multiple brands simultaneously.

Experience with Data Dive, Helium 10, and Amazon Brand Analytics. Soldscope

Experience using ClickUp, Notion, and automated project management workflows.

Experience building internal dashboards, applications, and AI agents.

Experience managing Meta, TikTok, influencer, or other external marketing initiatives.



What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Understand the assigned brands and identify their biggest growth opportunities and operational challenges.

Develop actionable solutions for the highest-priority performance issues.

Demonstrate measurable progress in resolving brand-level problems.

Establish clear project priorities, assignments, and deadlines with PPC and graphic design teams.

Improve accountability and on-time completion of important initiatives.

Identify key operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions.

Build or deploy at least two useful AI-powered tools or automations that improve productivity or eliminate repetitive work.

Demonstrate independent decision-making, initiative, and accountability for results.



The Type of Person We're Looking For

You're analytical, but you don't stop at analyzing.

You identify problems, research solutions, take action, and measure the outcome.

You're comfortable leading teams, assigning projects, establishing priorities, and holding people accountable.



You're technically curious and actively experiment with AI tools to develop smarter ways of working.

When you encounter an inefficient process, you don't simply accept it. You look for ways to improve it, automate it, or build something better.



Most importantly, you take ownership of the results.



If this sounds like you and you would like to apply. Please send your resume directly to myself with the subject line : SBM with Passion for AI





Tam Ma

Co Founder - Prodigy Media

title: $1000/mo Remote Assistant (Admin, Finance & LinkedIn Outreach)
description:
The job will pay $1000/mo USD.



In Founders Words is a LinkedIn ghostwriting agency. We write LinkedIn content for founders and executives at tech startups and scale-ups, helping them build their presence and grow their businesses.



7 reasons why you will love this job:

1. $1,000 per month (plus 13th month pay)

2. I plan on working with you for a long time if it goes well (this will be steady)

3. You will learn valuable skills you can apply for the rest of your career (I will invest in you)

4. You will have autonomy. I am not a micromanager at all and only care that good work gets done

5. You will have purpose - the work we do is changing peoples' lives for the better

6. You will develop mastery in several skills

7. There are opportunities for career advancement if you do a great job



What you'll do:

This is a hybrid role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will go to admin, client operations and finance, and roughly 30–40% to LinkedIn outreach. Both for the owner of In Founders Words Dan and for clients. Your role will grow over time and you will get additional responsibilities.



Admin, operations & finance (60–70%):

- Scheduling LinkedIn posts for clients and keeping content calendars up to date

- Gather data on a weekly basis and spot which LinkedIn posts and formats perform best

- Assist with client account management and reminders

- Send monthly reports to clients (don't need to create from scratch, we have a tool that creates these reports - needs to be checked and sent)

- Put client writing into carousels and other visual formats (no design skills needed - we have a tool for, would only be refining)

- Find and collect top-performing LinkedIn posts across all clients that can be recreated for others

- Cross promote and repurpose content on LinkedIn and Substack

- Format and schedule posts on Substack

- Send invoices on time and follow up on late payments

- Track income and expenses, organize receipts and keep the bookkeeping up to date (we have tools to help, but need someone to oversee and manage)

- Keep track of subscriptions, renewals and recurring payments

- Constantly look for opportunities to automate and speed things up with AI and tools

- Other Admin tasks as they come up



LinkedIn outreach (30–40%):

- Build leads lists LinkedIn, with Sales Navigator and scrape lists

- Send connection requests and 20-40 LinkedIn DMs per day, following scripts

- Send follow-ups and flag anyone who replies so I can take over the conversation

- Keep our outreach tracker up to date



I am looking for someone who can:



- Is very organized

- Keep track of things

- Write & speak well in English

- Move data from one place to another

- Handle numbers carefully and keep financial records accurate

- Build lists on LinkedIn, Sales Navigator and scrape lists

- Send connection requests and DMs for clients

- Learn new skills through courses that I will provide access to and YouTube videos

- Be self-reliant and use Google, Claude or ChatGPT to figure things out



If you have experience in LinkedIn, Slack, Claude, Substack, bookkeeping or invoicing software, that's a plus. I'm looking for someone who wants a STABLE, SECURE, long-term job.



You will be expected to work 7am - 3pm Amsterdam time (2pm - 10pm Philippine time, one hour earlier during European summer time) Mon-Fri as a full-time contractor.



Some things I really care about:

- That you are proactive about solving problems

- That you always respond quickly to Slack messages during work hours

- That you have great attention to detail, especially with numbers and money

- That you want to learn and grow

- That you want to work here for several years



If you're interested, do the following:



1. Write two or more paragraphs about yourself, your greatest strengths, and your greatest weaknesses. Please address any of the things we're looking for with details on how you meet those qualifications.

2. Send a link to a video of yourself using Loom answering the following...



Logistics:



• When can you start?

• Go to https://www.speedtest.net/ and click "Go" so I can see your internet speed.

• Tell me about your Internet access, computer, electricity, and backup plan if electricity fails (Availability to work)

• After reviewing the job posting again, tell me when you're available to work during the week and how that will work with family members, significant others, kids, etc.

• Are you organized? Is there anything you can show or tell me so I can know you are?

• Anything else you want to add on why we should hire you?



If you do well on the test, we'll set up a video interview. I'll want to do part of the video interview by typing, to verify you can communicate well through writing. Then I'll want to do part of the interview verbally.

title: Operations Admin
description:
Job Summary



The Operations Administrative Assistant provides day-to-day administrative and operational support to ensure moving jobs run smoothly, crews are properly coordinated, and client information is accurately documented. This role assists with crew tracking, move verification, customer follow-ups, COI processing, review generation, and general operational monitoring.



Key Responsibilities



1. Crew Coordination and Monitoring

Follow up with moving crews regarding their current location, arrival time, and job progress.

Confirm crew arrival at pickup and delivery locations.

Monitor crew status and report delays, missed check-ins, or other operational concerns.

Follow up on missing job updates, photos, signatures, or required documentation.

Escalate delays, scheduling conflicts, and customer concerns to the Operations Manager.



2. Customer Communication and Review Requests

Call clients after completed moves to request feedback and online reviews.

Follow up with clients regarding their moving experience and unresolved concerns.

Record customer feedback and update the review tracking sheet.

Escalate complaints, service issues, or negative feedback to the appropriate manager.

Assist with customer follow-up calls, confirmations, and other communications as needed.



3. Certificate of Insurance (COI) Coordination

Follow up on outstanding COI requests with clients, building management, and insurance representatives.

Track COI requirements, submission status, and outstanding documents.

Coordinate the collection of building requirements and relevant information needed for COI processing.

Confirm whether COIs have been submitted and follow up on pending approvals.

Notify the operations team of outstanding COIs that may affect scheduled moves.



4. Scheduling and Dispatch Support

Assist in confirming upcoming move schedules and crew assignments.

Verify that crews have the necessary job details, addresses, contact information, and special instructions.

Follow up on schedule changes, cancellations, and rescheduled moves.

Help identify potential scheduling conflicts and communicate them to the operations team.

Assist with preparing daily job lists and operational updates.



5. Documentation and Data Management

Maintain accurate and updated job records, trackers, and operational reports.

Organize job-related documents, photos, customer information, and other supporting records.

Ensure completed jobs are properly documented and missing information is followed up.

Update CRM, dispatch, and other operational systems as required.

Maintain organized digital files and follow established documentation procedures.



6. Payment and Job Completion Follow-up

Assist in confirming whether required job completion documents have been submitted.

Flag missing payment confirmations or outstanding collection information to the responsible team.

Follow up with the relevant personnel regarding incomplete job records that may affect billing.

Coordinate with the operations or finance team to resolve missing information before job closure.



7. Reporting and Operational Monitoring

Prepare daily operational updates covering crew status, completed moves, pending documentation, and unresolved issues.

Maintain trackers for customer reviews, COI requests, job completion, and outstanding follow-ups.

Identify recurring delays, incomplete records, and issues requiring management attention.

Provide timely updates to the Operations Manager regarding pending tasks and escalations.



8. General Administrative and Ad Hoc Support

Assist with general administrative tasks and operational projects.

Respond to
s, make outbound calls, and coordinate with crews, clients, vendors, and internal teams.

Follow up on outstanding tasks to ensure timely completion.

Support process improvements and help maintain standard operating procedures.

Perform other reasonable administrative and operational duties as assigned.



Qualifications and Requirements

Previous experience in operations, administrative support, dispatch, logistics, or customer service is preferred.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Comfortable making outbound calls and following up with different stakeholders.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and data-entry systems.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Proactive approach to following up on outstanding tasks and escalating issues.

Experience with moving company operations, CRM systems, or dispatch software is an advantage.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timeliness and accuracy of crew location and job-status updates.

Percentage of completed moves with complete and accurate records.

Timeliness of COI follow-ups and tracking.

Number of customer review requests completed.

Timely follow-up and escalation of operational issues.

Accuracy of trackers and daily operational reports.

Completion of assigned administrative tasks within deadlines.



Working Arrangement

Position: Operations Administrative Assistant

Department: Operations

Reports To: Operations Manager or designated supervisor

Primary Focus: Crew coordination, move verification, customer follow-ups, COI tracking, documentation, and daily operational support.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm looking for a high-level Personal Executive Assistant to work directly with me as my right hand. This is not a basic admin job, and I'll be upfront: this is a demanding role. You will operate closely with me day-to-day helping manage my calendar, priorities, communication, projects, and personal logistics as our startup scales fast.



You must speak English with little to no accent.



I'm the co-founder of BookDrop, a rapidly growing bulk book logistics and resale company. Our environment moves quickly and expectations are high. I need someone who is organized, proactive, warm in communication, and genuinely hungry to be the best executive assistant they can possibly be. Not someone looking for a comfortable job. Someone looking to be great at this.

This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines working Arizona hours (starting 5:00 AM AZ time). Expect roughly 50 hours per week. This is not a job for the weak. It IS a job for someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility, grow alongside a scaling company, and become indispensable to an executive long-term.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Act as my right-hand partner in daily execution and organization

Manage calendar, scheduling, reminders, and priorities

Organize communication, follow-ups, and task tracking

Support operations, growth projects, and leadership workflows

Build clean systems in Google Sheets and other tools

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) daily to draft, research, organize, and move faster

Help reduce noise so I can stay focused on high-level work



This role requires serious initiative. You don't wait to be told every step. You think ahead, bring solutions, and stay steady even when things move fast. A lot will be expected of you, and the right person will love that.





REQUIRED SKILLS



-Advanced Google Sheets skills

-Real, hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT (this is non-negotiable, you should be using AI as a daily work multiplier, not just something you've tried once)

-Strong English communication (written and spoken)

-Highly organized and comfortable juggling many priorities at once

-Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools

-Reliable internet and ability to work US hours





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Supporting founders or C-level leaders

Project management or workflow systems

Automation, systems thinking, or building AI-powered workflows



WHO THRIVES HERE



Someone who genuinely wants to be the best EA in the room, not just employed as one

Organized but adaptable

Positive, warm, and confident communicator

Calm under pressure with extremely high standards

Independent thinker who enjoys close collaboration

Someone excited to be fully invested and grow long-term in a right-hand role



If you read the hours and expectations above and felt excited instead of nervous, you're probably who I'm looking for.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume to 
 with "book time" in the subject line and include a ~2-minute video covering:



What is your favorite non-fiction book and why?

Then, why you’d be a good fit? 

This is to judge your English and fit for the role.

Be camera ready with a warm, positive personality

Send any attatchments that show your Google Sheets/AI Knowledge and skills



Applications without both a resume and video will not be reviewed.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we need an eCommerce VA who is reliable, self-driven, and sharp with details, someone who wants a real career with us, not just a stopgap. We run the daily operations of online brands for clients around the world, and you'll support several of them at once. No two days look alike. Expect busy task lists, last-minute changes, fast turnarounds, and priorities that shift quickly. We need someone who stays organized, follows our processes, handles pressure well, and keeps quality high when things get hectic.



Role details:

- Start date: as soon as possible

- Full-time, long-term

- Graveyard shift (Philippine time), Monday to Friday

- Weekends off

- Occasionally, we may ask for extra hours for urgent client requests or deadlines. It won't be every day, but flexibility matters in our fast-paced setting.



What you'll do:

- Run and maintain Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

- Build, edit, and optimize product listings

- Research products, competitors, and market trends

- Help with customer support and order handling

- Keep websites updated and take care of general admin

- Support our marketing and content work

- Create simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

- Make basic layout and design improvements to websites

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Follow our systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions

- Manage tasks across multiple client accounts

- Respond quickly to updates and requests during your shift

- Keep your work organized and on time during busy periods



As you prove your reliability, we'll give you more: greater independence with client accounts and bigger, higher-value projects.



Who we're looking for:

- You have hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, store updates, theme edits, and order management

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You're highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You're hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You're fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Experience with WooCommerce, Amazon, or TikTok Shop

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Beyond Shopify, experience isn't everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the other platforms and tools, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: up to ₱5,000, based on performance

- ₱1,500 signing bonus after completing the probationary period

- Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn't for everyone

We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you're after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A screenshot of your internet speed test

- Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

- A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience (especially your Shopify work), and telling us why you're the right person for this role



Important: Put "ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)" in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We're looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you're disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Security Compliance Program Lead
description:
About the Engagement



We're pursuing SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification concurrently, on a fixed schedule, and need someone to take the program from kickoff to a clean report/certificate — then hand off a running program to an internal owner.



Two dates anchor the engagement and do not move: the ISO 27001 certificate in March 2027 and the SOC 2 Type II report in May 2027. There's no slack before January, so month one is spent locking auditor commitments, not writing documents.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a supervisory one. You'll write the policies, chase the evidence, and sit in the audit meetings yourself — working across engineering, IT, HR, legal, and field operations, none of whom report to you. The work runs on influence and follow-through, not authority.



Key Deliverables

-ISMS scope statement and SOC 2 system description — Due Nov 2026 / Jan 2027

-Risk assessment (ISO 27001 clause 6.1) + risk treatment plan — Due Dec 2026

-Approved policy set (~20 policies, Annex A structure) — Due Nov 2026

-Statement of Applicability, all 93 Annex A controls — Due Dec 2026

-Compliance platform configured and collecting evidence — Due Nov 2026

-Remediation complete and evidenced across all teams — Due Dec 2026

-Vendor risk register, third-party reports, signed DPAs — Due Dec 2026

-Penetration test commissioned; critical findings closed — Due Dec 2026

-ISMS internal audit and management review documented — Due Dec 2026

-SOC 2 Type I report issued — Due Jan 2027

-ISO 27001 certificate issued — Due Mar 2027

-SOC 2 Type II report issued, no material exceptions — Due May 2027

-Handover pack + trained internal owner — Due Jun 2027



What You'll Do

-Own the program plan, schedule, and budget; report progress to leadership monthly

-Contract and manage the CPA firm and certification body — scheduling, evidence requests, walkthroughs, findings/responses

-Define and document one scope boundary serving both frameworks

-Write the policies, Statement of Applicability, and system description

-Drive cross-team remediation (access control, logging, encryption, change management, onboarding/offboarding), holding owners to dates and escalating early

-Administer the compliance automation platform and keep evidence collection running

-Run vendor risk reviews; collect third-party reports and DPAs

-Coordinate the penetration test, internal audit, and management review

-Document the running program and train the internal owner who takes it on



Requirements



Required

-Has personally taken a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement through to a clean report/certificate — as the owner, not a contributor

-3+ years in security compliance, GRC, IT audit, or closely related field

-Working knowledge of core security controls: IAM, MFA, logging & monitoring, encryption, endpoint management, change management

-Clear, plain writing — policies, system description, and audit responses are most of the output

-Able to hold people to commitments without line authority

-Available to start in October 2026, with a fixed end date



Preferred

-Has run both frameworks together, or mapped one control set across two

-Hands-on with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto, or similar)

-Background in IT services, managed services, or field services (environments with subcontractors/technician access to customer systems)

-CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification



Terms

-Structure: Open to independent contractor or fixed-term employment, whichever the candidate prefers

-Commitment: Full time; October 2026–February 2027 is the heaviest build sprint, pace eases once audits are underway

-Completion: Engagement ends when the Type II report is issued and handover is complete; an extension into the ongoing program may be offered but is not guaranteed to either party

-Milestone structure (contractors): A portion of fee may be tied to deliverables #10, #11, and #12 — terms to be agreed



How to Apply



Please submit:

-A summary of a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement you personally owned end-to-end, and the outcome

-Relevant certifications (CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor), if any

-Your availability for an October 2026 start

title: Support Specialist (PH)
description:
!!! READ ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING !!!



Support Specialist

We're looking for a Support Specialist to help Moxie move from siloed, ad hoc support to a unified front door for every practice. You'll field general, billing, and technical questions so that Engineering, Marketing, and Account Managers can focus on the work that needs their expertise. As we grow past 700 practices, you play a key part in making sure support quality holds steady while volume climbs.



You'll join a support team being built through a mix of internal transfers and new hires, working across Tier 0, Tier 1, and Tier 2 with our Concierge, FIN AI, and Intercom tooling. You'll inherit an existing ticket queue and escalation matrix, partner with Tier 2 subject matter experts in functional teams, and help shape the triage standards that every new teammate ramps into.





Our Objectives for the Role

- Resolve the full range of questions independently. Within three months you're ramped onto the ticket queue and independently resolving a meaningful share of recurring general, billing, and basic technical questions without escalating, using the Tier 0/1/2 structure and escalation matrix to route anything outside your scope.

- Fix one real pain point in your first quarter. Take ownership of an existing issue in the support process, such as a backlog category, a documentation gap, or a recurring escalation bottleneck, and deliver a fix or measurable improvement.

- Own a slice of the queue end to end. By month six you manage a defined portion of the support queue, across general, billing, and technical tickets, with minimal oversight.

- Reduce the load on specialist teams. Through better FIN AI content, documentation, and your own judgment calls, you cut the number of questions in your area that need escalation, and you contribute to SLA tracking and visibility for tickets that reach Tier 2.

- Help the team scale by month nine. You're a fully ramped teammate that newer hires and transfers rely on, you can point to lower ticket volume reaching specialist teams, faster resolution times, and higher practice satisfaction, and you contribute to the roadmap for what to automate next and how the team divides ownership as it grows.





We're Looking For

- Experience in customer support, ideally in a SaaS or software environment, handling more than one type of question across a live ticket queue

- Comfort learning a product deeply. You can learn the core workflows of a software platform well enough to answer general, billing, and basic technical questions without handing them off, and you know when a question truly needs a specialist.

- Sound triage judgment. You can read a ticket, d
 whether to resolve, deflect, or escalate, and route it to the right tier with the context the next person needs.

- Experience with support tooling and AI-assisted support. You've worked in Intercom, Zendesk, or a similar platform, and you have a point of view on how an AI agent like FIN and good documentation reduce the tickets a human has to touch.

- Clear, warm written communication. You explain billing and technical issues to practice owners and their teams in plain language, and your answers are consistent no matter who else picks up the ticket.

- An improvement mindset. You notice gaps in documentation, process, or expectations, flag them to your manager or Lead, and follow through on a fix instead of working around them.

- Collaborative by default. You build relationships across the support team and with Tier 2 SMEs in Engineering, Marketing, and Account Management, and you enjoy helping teammates who are newer than you get up to speed.



This is not a role for someone who wants to work only one ticket category or hand off anything unfamiliar; you'll be expected to build range across general, billing, and technical support.





Why Join Us?

- You help build a unified front door for support at a company serving more than 700 practices, and the standards you help set become the standard for every new teammate.

- A team in motion, with internal transfers and new hires joining together, so there's real room to shape how ownership is split as we grow.

- Direct exposure to every part of the business through partnership with Tier 2 SMEs in Engineering, Marketing, and Account Management, plus modern tooling (Intercom, FIN AI, and Concierge) built around deflection.

- A clear path from ramped teammate to go-to mentor, with your process improvements adopted team-wide.

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, Med Spas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- Competitive salary.

title: Operations Execution
description:
Operations Execution Lead

Compensation: $2,400/month



Mission

Turn priorities into finished results.



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.



Your job is to own that execution.



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.



Either way, you own the result.



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.





Operating Rules

Own the result. Do not pass problems.

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.

No proof = not done.

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.



What You Own



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.



Examples:

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.

Coordinate cleanouts.

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.



Do not report that a unit is stuck.



Get it unstuck.



2. BOTG & Vendor Management



Own the people who execute work locally.

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.

Give clear scopes and deadlines.

Get quotes.

Follow up.

Verify work.

Correct poor work.

Replace underperformers.

Maintain backup options.



“I asked them” is not a result.



The work being completed correctly is the result.



3. Projects & Procurement

Own independent projects from idea to completion.



Examples include:

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.

Research and negotiate vendors or services.

Sell unused assets.

Coordinate property improvement projects.

Build new operational processes.

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.



4. Operational Problem Resolution

When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.

Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.

Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.

Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.



What Winning Looks Like

Work gets completed on time.

Projects do not stall.

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.

Completed work is actually complete.

Asana reflects reality.

Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort.



This Role Is a Fit If You

Are a doer.

Take ownership without reminders.

Finish what you start.

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.

Follow up relentlessly.

Make good decisions independently.

Keep many moving pieces organized.

Communicate problems early.

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.

Care about details and proof.

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.

title: Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)
description:
Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)



Company: Eveready Express

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time)

Location: Remote



About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.



The ideal candidate must have at least two (2) years of experience working in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry and possess strong dispatching, route planning, and load coordination skills. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to effectively multitask, possess intermediate English communication skills, demonstrate expert computer skills, and have a growth mindset with a willingness to continuously learn and improve.



As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched

26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb. weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans

Cargo Vans

Ram ProMaster (High Roof)

About Eveready Express



Founded in 1984, Eveready Express is a trusted leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution services. We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Dispatch vehicles based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.

Negotiate rates with drivers while maintaining a target minimum 40% gross margin.

Assign loads efficiently to maximize profitability and operational performance.

Coordinate pickups and deliveries to ensure customer service expectations are met.

Driver Communication

Maintain continuous communication with drivers throughout their routes.

Provide dispatch instructions, updates, route changes, and operational support.

Ensure drivers follow company procedures and customer requirements.

Routing & Scheduling

Plan efficient delivery routes to minimize transit time, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

Adjust schedules quickly as operational needs or unforeseen circumstances arise.

Balance driver availability with customer delivery requirements.

Shipment Tracking

Monitor shipments in real time using GPS and dispatch software.

Proactively identify delays and coordinate solutions to minimize service disruptions.

Provide timely shipment updates to customers and internal teams.

Customer Service

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch.

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain accurate dispatch records, driver logs, shipment notes, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and Proofs of Delivery (PODs).

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Problem Solving

Resolve logistical challenges including traffic delays, vehicle breakdowns, weather disruptions, missed appointments, and last-minute schedule changes.

Safety & Regulatory Compliance

Verify driver qualifications, vehicle readiness, insurance, and compliance with company safety standards.

Work closely with HR and Operations to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.

Team Collaboration

Collaborate with Customer Service, Operations, Billing, Sales, HR, Warehouse, and Drivers to ensure seamless daily operations.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve dispatch efficiency, operational workflows, and customer satisfaction.

Recommend process improvements and innovative solutions to management.

Qualifications

Required: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry.

Previous experience dispatching 26-foot box trucks, cargo vans, sprinter vans, or final-mile delivery vehicles is required.

Strong understanding of DOT regulations, ELD compliance, and Hours of Service (HOS) requirements.

Experience negotiating driver rates while maintaining profitability and service quality.

Expert computer skills, including the ability to quickly navigate multiple applications, browser tabs, spreadsheets, dispatch platforms, and communication tools simultaneously.

Proficiency with Transportation Management Systems (TMS), dispatch software, GPS tracking platforms, load boards, CRM systems, Microsoft Office (especially Excel), Google Workspace, and web-based applications.

Strong ability to multitask and manage multiple drivers, customers, deliveries, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal).

Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable communicating professionally with drivers, customers, brokers, and internal teams.

Strong critical-thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

Dependable, self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Demonstrates a growth mindset, is coachable, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

Must be available to work a full-time schedule, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as operational needs require.

Hardware & Technical Requirements



Applicants must have the following:



Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 or equivalent preferred)

RAM: Minimum 16 GB

Storage: At least 100 GB of available disk space

Second monitor for efficient multitasking

title: Structural Engineer – Steel Structures & Carport Design
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Structural Engineer** in the Philippines who can independently design steel structures, particularly **steel carports, canopies, covered parking structures, and similar projects**.



The ideal candidate must be capable of taking a project from initial concept through structural analysis, member sizing, connection design, and preparation of complete engineering drawings ready for review and stamping by our licensed U.S. Professional Engineers.



### Responsibilities



- Perform structural analysis and design of steel carports, canopies, and similar structures.

- Identify and size structural members, including beams, columns, rafters, bracing, base plates, and connections.

- Use structural engineering software such as **RISA-3D**, STAAD.Pro, or equivalent.

- Design for applicable gravity, wind, and other structural loads in accordance with U.S. building codes.

- Prepare structural calculations and supporting documentation.

- Develop complete structural drawings using AutoCAD or similar drafting software.

- Coordinate revisions and prepare final deliverables for review, approval, and sealing by our U.S. Professional Engineers.



### Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.

- Proven experience designing steel structures.

- Proficiency in RISA-3D or comparable structural analysis software.

- Strong AutoCAD drafting skills.

- Familiarity with U.S. structural design standards, including IBC, ASCE 7, and AISC.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong English communication skills.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume and relevant engineering experience.

2. **Samples of steel structural designs and drawings you have personally completed**, particularly carports or similar structures.

3. Structural engineering software you are proficient in.

4. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary.

5. Your availability to begin work.



**We can provide sample projects to qualified candidates** to demonstrate the type of work we regularly perform. A short paid design assessment may be requested before hiring.



We are looking for someone who can handle both the **engineering design and drafting**, not simply a CAD operator.



This is an opportunity for ongoing work with an established Texas engineering firm.

This is an as-needed, project-based position, with workload varying depending on incoming projects—potentially 4 to 20 hours per week. Applicants must accurately track their time on each project and will be compensated hourly. Experience with RISA-3D is highly preferred, and having your own license is a plus; however, a license can be provided to a qualified candidate. AutoCAD proficiency is required.

title: Legal Intake Specialist (Sales)
description:
ABOUT US

All 50 Law is a US-based, rapidly expanding personal injury law firm dedicated to helping individuals who have recently suffered an injury secure the legal support they need. We are quickly growing to become one of the largest marketing and referral-based law firms in the country. Behind our fast-paced, highly automated marketing machine is a powerhouse team: our founder is a Harvard Law School graduate, and our technical infrastructure is driven by a specialized team of product engineers holding Master’s degrees and PhDs in Computer Science.



THE ROLE

This is not a traditional administrative legal role; it is a high-performance sales position designed for a natural closer. We are seeking an individual who is assertive and competitive, yet highly people-oriented and relationship-focused. You must operate with a strong sense of urgency and adaptability, requiring a candidate who possesses balanced independence and procedural discipline. In this role, the specialist sells via phone or digital channels. You will be someone who expertly manages a pipeline and drives revenue without face-to-face interaction. Your primary objective is to build rapid trust, skillfully overcome hesitations, and guide prospects to retain our partner law firms.



A DAY IN THE LIFE

When you log in to your dedicated workspace, you will immediately dive into our custom GoHighLevel CRM. Your day will be heavily phone-based and fast-paced. You will constantly monitor incoming pipelines and jump on fresh, warm leads the moment our marketing engine generates them.



You will spend your hours speaking directly with individuals who have recently experienced an injury, requiring you to balance empathy with strong conversational control. You will ask targeted qualifying questions, navigate objections, and firmly guide eligible prospects toward signing a representation agreement. Between calls, you will aggressively manage your sales pipeline, send follow-up text messages,
s, and update client records with meticulous accuracy. You are the vital first point of contact, operating at a high frequency to turn inbound inquiries into closed deals.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

*Jump on Fresh Leads: Act with speed to engage immediately with individuals who have suffered injuries. Because these are warm leads expecting your call, your "speed to lead" is critical in capturing their interest while they are actively exploring their legal options.



*Qualify & Convert: Actively listen and assess each caller's case eligibility based on strict, provided criteria. You will ask targeted questions to uncover key details, seamlessly transitioning from qualification to the close.



*Control the Conversation: Use persuasive, confident communication to "sell" the advantages of working with our legal network. You must expertly navigate objections, instill trust, and motivate prospective clients to take the next step of signing their agreements.



*Manage Multiple Channels: Juggle prospect communication across phone calls, SMS text messages,
s, and social media direct messages to ensure systematic follow-up.



*Accurate Execution: Maintain impeccable detail orientation while logging notes and updating statuses. Your procedural discipline ensures our automated systems fire correctly and client data is preserved.



WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

*The "Hunter" Mentality: You are highly motivated, thrive on hitting targets, and get energized by closing deals.



*Extroverted & Outgoing Personality: You are naturally comfortable asserting yourself and taking control of a conversation. You build rapport instantly and can handle emotionally charged situations with professional confidence.



*Phone Presence: You are comfortable spending the majority of your shift on the phone. You maintain a high level of enthusiasm, empathy, and energy from your first dial to your last.



*Communication Mastery: You possess fluent English with very little or no detectable accent, ensuring crystal-clear communication and immediate trust-building with our clientele.



*Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience navigating the GoHighLevel CRM (or similar advanced sales platforms) and can quickly adapt to our proprietary technological tools.



*Remote Work Ready: You have a dedicated and distraction-free home workspace, supported by a reliable, high-speed internet connection.



WHAT WE OFFER

*Competitive Base + Uncapped Commission: Start with a $10/hr base rate, augmented by a lucrative commission structure. High performers have the clear opportunity to push $40k+/yr in total compensation through uncapped commissions and performance incentives.



*Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Work within a custom-built instance of GoHighLevel, supercharged by proprietary tools and automation developed in-house by our software engineering team.



*Warm, High-Intent Leads: 100% of the leads you engage with have actively requested our help and are expecting to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include a link to a voice recording saying: "Hi Ryan, my name is [your name] with All 50 Law. I'm following up on the form you submitted to us through
 seeking legal representation. Please call me back at your earliest convenience." Applications without this recording will not be considered.

title: Social Media Specialist, Content Creator & AI Video Creation Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a creative, proactive, and highly organised Social Media Specialist & Content Creator to manage and grow our brand’s online presence across Instagram,
, and TikTok, with the potential to expand onto Pinterest and YouTube.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how to create engaging content, build an online community, and use social media to increase brand awareness, attract customers, and drive sales. Main focus on AI content creation and videos.



The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for detail, a passion for digital content, and proven experience in filming, editing, and producing high-quality videos. They should be confident turning ideas into compelling visual content, keeping up with trends, and developing creative strategies that help a brand stand out in a competitive market. MUST BE ABLE TO USE AI TO CREATE VIDEOS.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the entire content creation process, from brainstorming ideas and planning filming sessions to editing videos, publishing posts, engaging with followers, and analysing performance.



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Strategy & Management



- Develop, implement, and manage social media strategies aligned with the brand’s objectives and target audience.

- Manage and grow the brand’s Instagram,
, and TikTok accounts, with the potential to expand onto additional platforms.

- Plan, schedule, and publish consistent, high-quality content using social media management tools.

- Create and maintain a monthly content calendar covering posts, Reels, TikToks, Stories, campaigns, promotions, and key dates.

- Ensure consistency across all platforms in terms of brand identity, messaging, tone of voice, and visual aesthetics.

- Stay up to date with social media trends, platform updates, algorithms, trending audio, hashtags, and best practices.

- Research competitors and identify opportunities to improve the brand’s social media presence and stand out online.



2. Video Creation, Filming & Editing



- Plan, film, edit, and produce engaging short-form videos for Instagram/ Reels, TikTok, and
 Reels.

- Take responsibility for the full video production process, from developing concepts and writing scripts to filming, editing, and publishing the final content.

- Create a variety of video content, including product showcases, demonstrations, tutorials, behind-the-scenes footage, promotional videos, storytelling content, trend-led videos, and campaign videos.

- Film high-quality footage using a smartphone or camera, with an understanding of lighting, angles, composition, sound, and product presentation.

- Edit videos using CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro & AI apps. 

- Incorporate engaging opening hooks, subtitles, text overlays, transitions, voiceovers, music, and other editing techniques to capture attention and maintain viewer interest.

- Develop creative video concepts that reflect the brand’s identity, showcase products effectively, and appeal to the target audience.

- Plan filming sessions in advance, including shot lists, props, locations, scripts, and creative direction where appropriate.

- Repurpose content across different platforms while adapting video formats and editing styles to suit each audience.

- Experiment with different video formats, hooks, lengths, and approaches to identify what performs best.

- Monitor video performance, including views, watch time, retention, shares, saves, and engagement, and use these insights to improve future content.

- Meet agreed weekly and monthly video production targets.

 

3. Content Creation, Photography & Branding



- Create high-quality graphics, promotional posts, carousels, Instagram Stories, captions, and other social media assets.

- Produce visually appealing content that reflects the brand’s identity and maintains a consistent, professional aesthetic.

- Take product photographs and create visual assets suitable for social media campaigns and promotions.

- Use Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools & AI tools to produce professional graphics, marketing materials & videos.

- Write engaging captions, compelling calls to action, and clear promotional messaging.

- Develop creative concepts for product launches, seasonal campaigns, special offers, announcements, and other marketing activities.

- Ensure all content is accurate, appropriately formatted, proofread, and aligned with brand guidelines before publication.

- Organise and maintain a library of video footage, photographs, graphics, and other digital assets.



4. Creative Direction & Initiative



- Proactively generate fresh content ideas and recommend innovative ways to showcase the brand.

- Identify relevant trends and assess how they can be adapted to suit the brand rather than simply copying existing content.

- Develop creative campaign ideas that increase audience interest and encourage interaction.

- Take ownership of content creation from concept to completion, working independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.

- Bring new ideas to management and contribute to the ongoing development of the brand’s visual identity and online presence.

- Continuously look for opportunities to improve content quality, consistency, reach, and engagement.



5. Community Management & Customer Engagement



- Respond to direct messages, comments, and general enquiries in a timely, friendly, and professional manner.

- Build positive relationships with followers, customers, influencers, and relevant collaborators.

- Monitor brand mentions, customer feedback, comments, and online conversations.

- Maintain a professional brand image across all social media interactions.

- Escalate complaints, sensitive enquiries, or issues requiring management input.

- Identify frequently asked questions and customer concerns that could be addressed through informative posts and videos.



6. Social Media Marketing, Growth & Advertising



- Develop content strategies designed to increase brand awareness, reach, engagement, website traffic, enquiries, and sales.

- Create content that communicates product benefits, answers customer questions, builds trust, and encourages purchasing decisions.

- Incorporate clear calls to action into relevant posts, videos, Stories, and campaigns.

- Support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and other business marketing initiatives.

- Assist with planning, creating, managing, and optimising paid social media advertising campaigns.

- Develop creative assets for advertisements and test different video concepts, visuals, and messaging.

- Monitor advertising performance and work towards improving campaign effectiveness and return on investment.

- Identify opportunities for influencer partnerships, user-generated content, and brand collaborations.



7. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Improvement



- Track and analyse key social media metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, video views, watch time, website visits, enquiries, and conversions.

- Regularly review content performance to identify successful formats, topics, and creative approaches.

- Prepare clear, regular performance reports with insights and recommendations.

title: Podcast Content Strategist & Video Editor
description:
NOW HIRING: Podcast Content Strategist & Video Editor (Part-Time, Remote)



Pay: $8–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience

Hours: 10-15 hours per week initially, with growth potential

Location: Remote | Philippines preferred

Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

Start Date: As soon as possible



About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based business psychologist, leadership consultant, speaker, and entrepreneur. I work with business owners and executives to strengthen their leadership, build more effective organizations, and create businesses that can grow beyond their direct involvement.



I am looking for a talented, creative, and highly resourceful individual to help transform my existing podcasts, interviews, speaking engagements, and educational videos into compelling social media content.



This is NOT simply a video editing position.



I need someone who can watch a 90-minute interview, recognize the 10–15 most valuable moments, and turn those insights into engaging, professional short-form videos.



You should be able to recognize a powerful statement, an interesting perspective, a valuable business lesson, or a moment that would make an entrepreneur stop scrolling.



I will provide the original recordings, brand guidance, and overall content direction. You will bring the creativity, editorial judgment, technical skills, and initiative to transform that material into finished content.



Primary Responsibilities — Content Creation (75%)



* Review long-form podcasts, interviews, and speaking recordings to identify valuable short-form content.

* Select the strongest moments and provide timestamps, proposed hooks, and content recommendations.

* Produce professional Instagram Reels with clean editing, engaging openings, accurate subtitles, and appropriate visual enhancements.

* Create attractive, educational Instagram carousel/swipe posts using Canva or similar design software.

* Write compelling social media captions that align with my brand voice and audience.

* Develop creative content ideas based on my existing videos, expertise, and messaging.

* Organize content files, maintain a production calendar, and prepare approved posts for publishing.

* Review my existing social media content to maintain consistency while introducing fresh ideas.



Secondary Responsibilities — Business Development Research (25%)



* Research paid speaking engagements, leadership training contracts, consulting opportunities, and relevant RFPs.

* Identify opportunities that align with my qualifications and professional services.

* Track application deadlines, compensation information, and submission requirements.

* Prepare concise research summaries with direct application links.

* Eventually assist with drafting proposals and completing applications.



Who I’m Looking For



Required qualifications:



* Demonstrated experience editing short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.

* Experience working with long-form podcasts, interviews, educational content, or similar recordings.

* Strong English comprehension and writing skills.

* Ability to independently identify engaging, valuable content rather than relying entirely on AI-generated clip suggestions.

* Proficiency with video editing tools such as CapCut, Descript, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

* Strong Canva or comparable graphic design skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

* Ability to follow brand guidelines while contributing original ideas.

* Strong internet research skills and the ability to work independently.



Preferred qualifications:



* Experience supporting coaches, consultants, professional speakers, or educational brands.

* Familiarity with business, leadership, entrepreneurship, or personal development content.

* Experience creating educational Instagram carousels.

* Familiarity with social media content planning and scheduling.

* Experience researching consulting opportunities, speaking engagements, or RFPs.



What Success Looks Like



I want to hand you a 90-minute recording and have you independently identify the most powerful content opportunities.



I want you to understand my audience well enough to recognize what will resonate with business owners.



I want finished Reels that are engaging, professional, and ready to publish.



And over time, I want someone who can take ownership of our content production process rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every task.



I value good judgment, initiative, creativity, and quality much more than simply producing a high volume of content.



Our Hiring Process



Selected applicants will be invited to participate in a seven-day paid skills assessment.



During this assessment, you will:



1. Review a long-form video and recommend 10–15 potential Reels with timestamps and proposed content.

2. Create 2–3 fully edited Reels from the clips I select.

3. Independently develop one original Instagram carousel aligned with my brand.

4. Research at least five relevant paid speaking or consulting opportunities.



The assessment will be compensated at an agreed fixed amount, with a defined scope and time budget.



Successful completion may lead to an ongoing part-time position with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction: Tell me about your experience and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



2. Your portfolio: Provide links to at least three examples of short-form videos you have personally edited. At least one should be repurposed from a longer podcast, interview, or educational recording.



3. Your editorial process: In 3–5 sentences, explain how you would approach reviewing a 90-minute podcast to identify its strongest moments.



4. Your design experience: Share one or two examples of educational Instagram carousel posts you have created.



5. Your availability: Include your hourly rate, available weekly hours, earliest start date, and experience working with U.S.-based clients.



6. Attention-to-detail question: At the end of your application, answer this question:



What makes a great 45-second educational Reel different from simply cutting 45 seconds out of a longer video?



Please include the phrase “Content With Purpose” in the subject line of your application.



Applications without relevant work samples will not be prioritized.



I am reviewing applications as they arrive and plan to begin interviews immediately.



I look forward to seeing your work!
