title: Virtual CIO (vCIO) – Strategic IT Consultant
description:
We are seeking a strategic and business-minded Virtual CIO (vCIO) to serve as a high-level advisor for our diverse portfolio of business clients. In this role, you will act as an extension of our clients' executive teams, bridging the gap between their business goals and their technology infrastructure.



As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

*Strategic IT Roadmapping & Planning

- Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clients to align technology with their 1–3 year business goals.

- Develop and maintain comprehensive IT roadmaps, including hardware lifecycle management, cloud migrations, and

security enhancements.

- Identify emerging technologies that can provide a competitive advantage or operational efficiency for specific client

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Assist clients in developing and managing annual IT budgets.

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

- Oversee client security postures, ensuring alignment with frameworks like NIST, CIS, or industry-specific regulations

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience with ITIL frameworks or MSP-specific vCIO tools.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?



*Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

*Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work while contributing to impactful projects.



How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your IT career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join a team that’s passionate about technology, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

description:

We’re Franky Amsterdam, a fast-growing jewelry brand from Amsterdam. We sell direct-to-consumer through our own Shopify store in Europe, the United States and Australia, and we’re planning to expand into even more markets soon.



Paid advertising is the engine of our growth. We’re looking for an experienced, all-round freelance media buyer who can fully own our performance marketing across Meta, TikTok and Google. Running campaigns is only part of the job: we want someone who thinks strategically, comes up with new ideas and executes them.



What you’ll do

Must-haves



- 3+ years of hands-on media buying for DTC e-commerce brands

- Proven experience on all three platforms: Meta, TikTok and Google Ads. We need someone who can do it all.

- A track record of scaling ad accounts profitably, ideally with a monthly spend of $75.000+

- Experience running campaigns in multiple countries or markets

- Strong understanding of creative strategy: you know why an ad works, not just that it works

- Excellent written English and good spoken English: we’ll have regular video calls

- Comfortable thinking strategically: you build a plan, test it, and adjust based on results

- Independent and proactive: you work like an entrepreneur and take full ownership of your results



Nice-to-haves



- Experience with European markets (Netherlands, Germany, etc.)

- Experience with fashion, jewelry or accessories brands

- Experience with Triple Whale and Shopify



What we offer



- A long-term freelance engagement with a growing international brand

- A fixed monthly fee

- Real ownership: you’ll shape our paid strategy across multiple markets

- Short lines and fast decisions: you’ll work directly with the team



How to apply

title: Head of Marketing — Paid Media, Retention & Ecommerce
description:
A profitable, growing US-based specialty tea CPG brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders, warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU) selling primarily through Shopify and TikTok Shop, built on authentic sourcing, education, and a founder-creator with millions of followers who is, today, the company's entire marketing engine. The brand ships frequent new product lines (two launches in the next four months alone) and runs a quarterly subscription program (~2,000 members) that is the growth core. The founder built the entire business on organic content and the company has never run paid ads. Marketing today is a set of good ideas with no owner:
, loyalty, referrals, collabs, community, contests. Your job is to become that owner, and to build the machine around the founder's audience instead of depending on it.

One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. All creative is real and hand-made. That is the brand's identity, not a policy. See "How this company uses AI" below; it will d
 whether this role is for you.



The role

You own marketing end to end. This is a content-led brand: high-quality entertainment and infotainment IS the acquisition engine, and everything you do in paid,
, and lifecycle has to interact coherently with the organic machine, not run beside it. You understand how paid and organic feed each other and you manage brand awareness as one system.

The mandate runs in a deliberate order. First, find the leaks and build the scoreboard: subscription drop-off, paused members, one-time buyers, and the KPI system to see it all. Second, stand up paid media and get the
 and lifecycle machine performing. Third, once the fundamentals run, expand into organic collaboration: creator collabs, bigger content plays, deeper integration with the founder's production. The wrong hire walks in asking for a big ad budget. The right hire walks in asking where the money is leaking and what the data says.

You are a player-coach, weighted toward player early. You personally run media strategy and media buying (today's AI-powered buying tools make this a one-person job at this scale) until the marketing arm grows enough to justify dedicated hands, at which point you help define that hire. The
 specialist reports to you and executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction. You'll also coordinate with the rest of the small team around marketing: a Shopify/ecommerce operations person and the founder's YouTube account manager.

On creative: you are close to a creative director who never creates. The founder is the creator. He likes performing, he WANTS to make ads, and he already has some in production. Your job is to make that enthusiasm strategic and intentional: understand the brand's edges and preferences deeply enough to direct
, paid media, and collab work cohesively without ever violating the ethos, and to tell him exactly what the data says he should make next. He will make you one great ad at a time, not fifteen mediocre ones.

This is not a strategy-deck job. You make tactical judgment calls on messaging, audiences, offers, and budget the same day they come up, and you push initiatives to done. The unofficial title is "the person who makes marketing ideas stop dying in the parking lot."



What you'll do

Find the leaks and build the scoreboard

Diagnose subscription drop-off: who leaves, when (the drop after box two and three is the known weak point), and why

Quantify how much meat is on the bone: lapsed members, paused subscriptions, one-time buyers who never subscribed,
 list segments that never converted



Think in the levers that multiply the business: LTV, AOV, CAC, churn, and net-new customers. When the data to see a lever doesn't exist, you fix the measurement system so it does

Run the win-back loop for paused and lapsed members, working with the internal AI survey systems that surface why people pause



Run paid media yourself

Launch paid ads from zero (Meta first, TikTok second) with an intro test budget, personally owning media strategy and buying with modern AI-powered tools



Approach ads from first principles: early paid is a learning instrument. Breaking even early on is a perfectly good outcome; the bar is don't bleed money while collecting the data that verifies hunches and shapes the growth plan, then refine and iterate from there



Run the full range deliberately: put cash behind organic content that's already working, test odd angles, and run boring direct-response ads. You have to be comfortable with both the weird and the boring

Build the creative testing plan around the founder's content and the ads he has in production; brief him on what to make next based on what the data says



Own holiday-season ad buying (Oct through Feb is the season)

Earn the budget: scale spend only as unit economics prove out, and be the person telling the founder when NOT to spend



Own
, lifecycle, and loyalty

Set strategy for and manage the
 specialist, who executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction

Evolve loyalty into a VIP program and fold the referral program into its tiers

Multiply LTV and AOV: bundles, premium tiers, subscription upgrades, win-backs

Expand the organic machine (stage two, after the fundamentals run)



Lead creator collab strategy, including YouTube collaborations: you set the strategy and direct it, with outreach and legwork resources added as the workload materializes

Surface-manage the content production workflow (the founder has a YouTube account manager) enough to keep it moving and connected to the rest of marketing

Deepen the paid-organic loop as both sides mature



Run the machine

Build the marketing calendar and own cross-channel coordination across Shopify and TikTok Shop: a constant new-product launch cadence (next two launches already scheduled for mid-September and November) and the holiday season

Direct the founder's creative production: batched, specific asks with clear briefs, on his rhythm

Run the AI marketing stack for analytics and orchestration, and teach: make sure the whole team understands what the numbers say and why



Be our eyes and ears on the marketing org: as channels prove out, you define the next roles the team needs and help us scope them



Who survives here

The founder runs this company as a creator and an artist. He will not work 70-hour weeks, he will not sit in frequent syncs, and he does not want to be managed hard. There are standing weekly team calls and brand-alignment checks; beyond that, you get batched, well-prepared asks and a lot of autonomy.

The person who thrives: a first-principles thinker who asks "what are the alternatives" and comes at problems from angles, cares deeply about brand ethos and being genuine, and is flexible and adaptable when the picture changes. Low ego, systems-builder, gets energy from ownership rather than access, treats the founder as a scarce production resource and designs the work around that constraint. A sense of humor is close to required: the brand runs on it. The person who fails: needs frequent alignment meetings, wants to "workshop the vision" repeatedly, bulldozes the founder's constraints in the name of growth, or is too proud to run boring ads.



How this company uses AI

The company runs a deliberate split: aggressive AI adoption in operations, a hard wall around anything creative or customer-facing. This role sits exactly on that line and has to hold it.



The wall (creative side)

- Nothing customer-facing is AI-generated. No AI images ever, no AI-written copy shipped as-is. This is brand identity, not a preference: the entire premise of the brand is that everything is real. Real sourcing trips, real photos, real people.

- The standard is cultural, not just a rule. Real example: product photos came back with dust on them right before a launch, the founder was unreachable, and the team spent hours manually retouching the dust out rather than AI-recreating the images, because they knew that is what he would want. That instinct is the hiring bar.

- AI-assisted drafting is tolerated only when the shipped output is written by hand or aggressively reviewed by hand. AI passing as human is the sin. A previous team member put an obviously AI-generated image into an internal test
; it never shipped and it was still treated as a serious culture violation.



The embrace (operations side)

- The company builds internal AI agents aggressively: live inventory and logistics answers for the CS team, a demand-prediction model for new products, and a customer survey loop that maps the customer journey.

- The founder's stated goal is a middle road: full transparency with the team about how AI is used, so nobody feels they are training their replacement, and AI kept as far from the creative side as possible.



What this means for you

- You manage the AI marketing setup: agent-driven ad analytics and orchestration (think "this ad is overperforming in one region, redivert budget"), AI-powered media buying, research, segmentation, reporting, workflow. Analytics and orchestration, yes. Generating ads, images, or copy that ships, no.

- You are also the translator: part of the job is making sure everyone on the team understands what the AI spend analytics say and why, in plain language.

- The founder believes AI slop is destroying trust in faceless content and low-tier influencer marketing, and that this brand's realness becomes MORE valuable as that happens. He has watched an agency lose his business by sending an unchecked AI-generated proposal. Pitching AI-generated creator content or mass AI outreach in your interview ends the interview.





What you've done before

- 6+ years across multiple marketing channels with your own hands: paid social,
/retention, loyalty or referral programs, influencer or community marketing

- Hands-on media strategy and media buying: you have personally planned, bought, and optimized paid media, not just supervised an agency doing it

- Food and beverage CPG experience is required: you have marketed a consumable product people buy repeatedly, and you understand replenishment cycles, taste-driven loyalty, and launch cadence

- Subscription experience is required: you have managed a subscription service and its retention economics, not just one-time - - DTC

- DTC ecommerce experience; Shopify fluency expected, TikTok Shop experience a strong plus

- Startup or small-team environments: you have been the whole marketing department before, comfortable with scrappiness and wearing every hat, not corporate structure and big budgets

- You understand content-led brands: experience running or working inside media/content production is a real asset, because here the content IS the marketing

- Ran frequent product launches end to end as the project manager, not just the channel owner; this brand ships new lines constantly and the calendar never stops

- Managed at least a small team or agency relationships; comfortable being the strategy layer for an executor

- Worked directly with a founder or creative director and can tell us how you adapted to them

- Comfortable managing AI agents and tools in your workflow; clear-eyed about where AI belongs and where it does not

- You should genuinely enjoy the product. Tea, tea culture, or Chinese culture as a real personal interest is close to a requirement here: this team lives the product, and it shows in the work. Comedic sensibility is a plus, since the founder's content runs on humor

title: Senior Google Ads + SEO Specialist - AI, CRO, Tracking (40-50k)
description:
ABOUT US



We are an Australian digital marketing agency. We run lead generation for trade and home service businesses: solar and battery, air conditioning, electrical, pools, roofing and builders. Every campaign is tracked from the click to the booked job, so we know what produced revenue and what only produced clicks.



We are small, fast and AI first. You will work directly with the founder, who has around 20 years of marketing experience.



We have not named the company in this ad on purpose. If your application gets through the first screen, we tell you exactly who we are by
, before any interview.



THE ROLE



We are adding Google Ads to what we offer our clients, and we want one senior person to own it.



Not someone who sets up a Search campaign and leaves it. Someone who understands how Google Ads works today, with AI doing much of the bidding and matching, and knows how to feed it the right data so it finds real customers instead of cheap clicks.



That means four things, and we need all of them:



1. Strategy. You d
 which campaigns a client needs, what to bid on, what to exclude, and how to structure the account. You can explain why.



2. Tracking and data. You set up conversion tracking properly, send real results back from our CRM into Google, and prove every number is correct. This is the part most specialists get wrong and the part we care about most.



3. Running it. You build, launch, watch and improve the campaigns, and report honestly on what they produced.



4. SEO and conversion. You have a strong SEO background and you know how to turn a landing page visit into an enquiry. Paid search, organic search and the page itself all work together, and you treat them that way.



You work alongside the founder, our CRM team and our creative team. We are AI first and we provide and pay for a Claude account that you will use every day. You must be genuinely willing to learn new workflows and tools.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Strategy and campaigns

- Audit an existing account and write a diagnosis before touching anything

- Choose the right campaign types for each client: Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Local Services Ads, and know when NOT to use each one

- Get the most out of Google's AI: Smart Bidding (Maximise Conversions, target CPA, value-based bidding), broad match done safely, AI Max for Search, Performance Max asset groups and audience signals

- Keyword research, negative keyword lists, search term reviews, and keeping budget away from junk searches

- Write ad copy and build assets that match what a homeowner is actually searching for

- Set up and manage Local Services Ads and connect Google Business Profiles



Tracking and data

- Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 set up and verified

- Google Ads conversion tracking for forms and calls, with enhanced conversions

- Capture the click ID and send CRM results back to Google (offline conversion import): qualified lead, booked, sold, so Google optimises for real jobs

- Call tracking set up and checked

- Consent mode understood and configured

- Test every conversion yourself and keep the proof



SEO

- Technical SEO audits: site speed, Core Web Vitals, indexing, crawl errors, sitemaps, schema for local businesses

- Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimisation, reviews strategy, citations, location and service pages

- Keyword and content strategy that wins organic traffic for service businesses in specific suburbs and cities

- Google Search Console set up, monitored and acted on

- Understand how AI search (Google AI Overviews and AI assistants) is changing what ranks, and adapt



Conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

- Review landing pages and tell us exactly why they are not converting: message match with the ad, speed, mobile layout, trust signals, the form, the call to action

- Plan and run A/B tests on pages and forms

- Use heatmaps and session recordings to find where people drop off

- Work with our page builders to make the changes, and measure the result



Reporting

- We measure cost per booked job, not cost per click or cost per lead

- If something failed, say so and say why

- You will be on calls with Australian business owners explaining your decisions



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Senior. Several years managing Google Ads with real budgets. Lead generation for local service businesses strongly preferred. Ecommerce only is a weaker fit

- A proven track record you can show: real accounts, real numbers, real results

- Genuine hands-on experience with Performance Max, Smart Bidding and offline conversion tracking, not just reading about them

- A strong SEO background, technical and local, with rankings you can show

- Real CRO experience: pages you improved and what happened to the conversion rate

- Careful. You check before you change and you test after

- Excellent written and spoken English



Nice to have: Google Ads certifications, GoHighLevel or another CRM, Meta Ads, Looker Studio, Australian market experience, trade or construction clients.



WHY JOIN US



- You work directly with a founder who has around 20 years of marketing experience, works with established multi-million dollar businesses, and works at a high level in AI.

- A team of 10+ professionals across every field we work in: video, design, CRM builds, development and AI.

- The best AI systems we can find, built into how we work every day.

- Good support and fast turnaround.

- A great environment to learn and to grow into a key player in the business.



THE MONEY, PLAINLY



PHP 40,000 to 50,000 per month, based on proven experience. Where you land in that range depends on what you can show us, not on what you claim.



On day one you get a written standard for this seat. At 60 days we review your delivery against it.



THE ARRANGEMENT, IN PLAIN TERMS



- Independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice us and we pay the invoice.

- You are responsible for your own tax and contributions. We do not pay SSS, PhilHealth or Pag-IBIG.

- No paid annual leave, no paid sick leave, no 13th month pay. We are telling you now so there are no surprises later.

- Paid twice a month, in PHP, by Wise.

- 7:00am to 3:30pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility for live client calls in Australian business hours.

- Full time and exclusive. No other retained clients and no other agencies while you are engaged with us.

- 3 month probation. Two weeks written notice, either way.

- A PAID test task before any offer: a real account audit, a campaign plan, and a written tracking plan. We pay for your time whether or not we make an offer.

- Your own computer, 25 Mbps or better internet, a backup connection, and a plan for power outages.

- You will be inside client accounts. You sign a contractor agreement and an NDA before you get access to anything.



HOW THE INTERVIEW WORKS



- If you pass the first screen, we
 you, tell you who we are, and offer one fixed interview time. Confirm it in writing or we do not hold it.

- If something comes up, tell us before the slot and we will rebook you once. If you do not turn up and did not tell us, your application is closed.

- The interview is a 30 minute screen share. We put a real Google Ads account on the screen and ask what you would change and why.

- Do not claim anything you cannot show live. Honest experience, even if small in places, is fine. A claim that disappears on screen is not.



HOW TO APPLY



Line one of your application must read: SEARCH followed by the total Google Ads spend you have personally managed, and the currency.



Example: SEARCH USD 180,000



Applications that do not start this way are not read. That is the only trick in this ad and we have just told you what it is.



Then seven things.



1. YOUR CV. Attached or linked. A LinkedIn profile on its own is not a CV.



2. THE LIST. Copy it and put ONE word next to every line. DONE = done it on a real account (say the industry). READ = understand it, never done it. NEVER = never done it or do not know what it means. Honest NEVERs beat a list of all DONEs, which we trust less, not more.



   1. Audited an underperforming account and written a diagnosis before changing anything

   2. Built and managed a Performance Max campaign for lead generation

   3. Used broad match with Smart Bidding without wasting the budget

   4. Used AI Max for Search

   5. Switched an account from manual bidding to Smart Bidding and measured the result

   6. Set up and managed Local Services Ads

   7. Built and maintained negative keyword lists from search term reviews

   8. Installed Google Tag Manager and GA4 with conversions verified

   9. Set up enhanced conversions

   10. Captured the click ID and imported offline conversions from a CRM

   11. Used value-based bidding with real job values

   12. Set up call tracking and call conversions

   13. Configured consent mode

   14. Worked to cost per booked job from CRM data, not just cost per lead

   15. Managed five or more Google Ads accounts at the same time

   16. Run Google Ads for a trade, home service or construction business

   17. Run a technical SEO audit and fixed what it found

   18. Ranked a local service business in the Google map pack for its main service

   19. Optimised a Google Business Profile and measured the result

   20. Ran an A/B test on a landing page and measured the change in conversion rate

   21. Used heatmaps or session recordings to find and fix a drop-off on a page



3. AN ACCOUNT YOU TURNED AROUND. One real account. In your own words: what was wrong, what you changed FIRST and why that first, what happened to the numbers, and what you would do differently now. A screenshot helps. The reasoning is what we are reading.



4. A TRACKING SETUP YOU BUILT. One real client. Walk us through how the conversions were tracked, how CRM results got back into Google, what broke, and how you proved it was working.



5. SEO AND CRO PROOF. One site you ranked (the keyword, where it started, where it got to) and one page you improved (what you changed and what happened to the conversion rate).



6. HOW YOU USE AI. One real example of how you use AI tools in your Google Ads or SEO work today, beyond Google's own automation.



7. YOUR NUMBER AND YOUR
.

- The monthly PHP figure you are working for now, and the figure you need to commit to us full time and exclusively.

- An
 address we can reach you on.



Write it yourself. Use AI to fix your spelling if you like. If AI writes your answers, it will show in the first three minutes of the interview, because we put a live account on the screen and ask what you would change.

title: Graphic Designer (Paid Social Ad Creative)
description:
About Penang Media



Penang Media is a London-based performance marketing agency for DTC brands. We run paid social for a focused mix of clients across footwear, supplements, and wellness, selling into the UK, EU, US, and Australia. We test a lot of ads every week, and we build tooling, AI included, so the team spends its time making work that wins rather than hunting for inputs.



The role



You’ll turn creative briefs into finished ads for our clients’ Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns: mostly statics, plus GIFs and simple motion. You’ll work from briefs set by our Lead Creative Strategist and Brand Success Manager, produce multiple variations of each concept across formats, and turn revisions around fast. Speed and volume matter as much as polish. Your output is what gets tested.



What you’ll do



• Design static ads for Meta from written briefs across feed, story, and carousel formats.

• Turn one concept into many: variations in layout, colour, headline, format, and style, so the team can test what works.

What we’re looking for



• 2+ years designing for ecommerce or DTC brands, with paid social ads in your portfolio (not just branding or logo work).

• Expert in Figma and Photoshop.

• Already using AI tools in your design work, or eager to start. We’ll give you access and we expect you to use it.

• Strong eye for layout, typography, and hierarchy, and the judgement to know when an ad is something people would stop scrolling for.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Fast. You can take a brief in the morning and have several finished variations by the afternoon.

Hours, pay, setup

• ₱41,000 to ₱58,000 per month depending on experience, paid monthly, plus 13th-month pay.

title: ECOMMERCE GRAPHICS ASSISTANT
description:
ECOMMERCE GRAPHICS ASSISTANT



About the role

We’re looking for an organised, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our team as an E-Commerce Graphics Assistant. In this role, you’ll support our brand portfolio, including Majority and Oakcastle, by adapting, localising and formatting visual content and product documentation across our international e-commerce marketplaces.



A primary focus of the role will be taking existing English graphics, product assets and user guides, running the copy through translation software, and cleanly fitting the translated text into established design templates.



You’ll work mainly with Adobe Illustrator and Microsoft PowerPoint, adapting existing designs, formatting manuals and supporting the wider team with a variety of ad hoc design and graphic tasks.



Main responsibilities

• Translate and localise Amazon listing images and A+ Content for different international marketplaces.

• Use translation tools to translate product copy and check the output for consistency, formatting and suitability within the asset.

• Add translated copy into existing graphics while maintaining the original layout, design and branding.

• Adapt comparison tables, feature graphics, product callouts and other Amazon assets for different languages.

• Translate and format product manuals, user guides and other product documentation.

• Use Microsoft PowerPoint and Adobe Illustrator to edit and adapt graphics.

• Check translated assets for formatting, product information, visual consistency and any obvious errors.

• Update graphics when product specifications, translations or content change.

• Keep files and translated assets organised and accessible to the wider team.

• Manage projects and deadlines across multiple products and markets.

• Communicate with the team about progress, questions or anything needed to complete a task.

• Support the Design and Marketing teams with ad hoc graphic design and content tasks, including resizing and adapting existing assets for different uses.

• Follow existing templates, brand guidelines and processes to keep content consistent.

What we’re looking for



Software experience:

Experience editing and adapting existing designs using Adobe Illustrator and Microsoft PowerPoint.



Eye for layout and design:

A good visual sense when it comes to typography, spacing, text hierarchy and line wrapping, particularly when working with longer translated text.



Confident using translation tools:

Comfortable using translation software to translate English text and working with the output to make sure it fits naturally within existing designs and layouts.



Strong attention to detail:

High accuracy when handling technical product information, feature callouts and specifications.



Organisation and time management:

Good file management habits and the ability to manage tasks and assets across multiple products and marketplaces.



Independent working:

Able to follow instructions, work efficiently within existing templates and raise questions when something is unclear.



Clear communication:

Good written and verbal English skills, with the ability to keep the team updated on task progress and deadlines.



Desirable experience

• Previous experience with Amazon listings or A+ Content.

• Experience working with e-commerce or product content.

• Experience translating or localising marketing content.

• Experience with consumer electronics or technical products.

• Experience working with product manuals or user guides.

• Experience adapting content for different European languages and marketplaces.



What the role looks like day to day

The role will involve a mix of translation work, Amazon content updates, product manuals and general graphic tasks.

You might spend one day adapting a set of Amazon listing images for several markets, and another updating a product manual, making changes to A+ Content or supporting the team with a smaller design task.



It’s a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working across different projects and can keep work accurate, organised and on schedule.

title: Senior Accountant — Controller Support | Healthcare & Education
description:
Senior Accountant — Controller Support | Healthcare & Education



Salary: PHP 50,000 per month  

Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Eastern Business Hours  

Location: Philippines-based candidates only



Annual salary increases based on performance, reliability, quality of work, and client satisfaction.



We are hiring an experienced accounting professional to serve as a dependable right hand to the Controller, supporting U.S.-based operations in healthcare and education.



You will take ownership of assigned accounting functions, prepare accurate reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and support month-end close and financial reporting. We need someone who understands the accounting behind the transactions, exercises sound judgment, and follows outstanding issues through to resolution.



Success in this role means delivering accurate, well-supported work on schedule, identifying problems early, and giving the Controller clear findings and proposed solutions.



## Key Responsibilities



**General Ledger and Account Reconciliations**



- Maintain accurate general ledger records, account coding, and supporting documentation.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, cash activity, and assigned balance sheet accounts.

- Investigate unusual balances, missing transactions, duplicate entries, and discrepancies across systems.

- Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and correcting entries for Controller review.

- Maintain clear reconciliation schedules showing balances, supporting details, and outstanding items.

- Ensure transactions are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.



**Month-End Close and Financial Reporting**



- Take ownership of assigned month-end close tasks and meet established deadlines.

- Prepare supporting schedules and financial reports for Controller review.

- Review account activity, identify inconsistencies, and explain significant changes.

- Support cash reporting, expense analysis, and other financial reporting needs.

- Prepare organized documentation for external accountants, audits, and financial reviews.

- Keep the Controller informed of unresolved issues, proposed adjustments, and deadline risks.



**Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Invoicing**



- Manage assigned AP and AR responsibilities with accuracy and timely follow-through.

- Review vendor bills for proper coding, supporting documentation, duplicates, and approvals.

- Reconcile vendor statements and resolve invoice, credit, and payment discrepancies.

- Prepare payment schedules and support payment processing under established approval procedures.

- Prepare and review customer invoices, including pricing, terms, classifications, and required details.

- Record receipts, apply payments correctly, and reconcile customer balances.

- Review AP and AR aging reports, investigate outstanding balances, and coordinate follow-up.

- Reconcile billing and operational records to QuickBooks.



**Controller Support and Process Improvement**



- Research accounting questions and present clear findings with recommended next steps.

- Track open items and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve them.

- Maintain organized accounting records and documented procedures.

- Identify recurring errors, gaps in documentation, and opportunities to improve accounting processes.

- Follow established internal controls and approval requirements.

- Handle confidential financial, employee, healthcare, and education-related information with discretion.



## Required Experience and Qualifications



- **Five or more years of hands-on accounting experience**, including general ledger reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close.

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based business.

- Experience working directly with a Controller, Accounting Manager, Finance Manager, or external accountant.

- Strong professional proficiency in **both QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop**.

- Solid understanding of accrual accounting and how transactions affect the balance sheet and income statement.

- Demonstrated ability to independently prepare reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and recommend appropriate corrections.

- Practical experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and high transaction volumes.

- Strong Excel skills, including lookup functions, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and comparisons across large datasets.

- Ability to produce organized, accurate work that is ready for Controller review.

- Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain accounting issues clearly.

- Dependable attendance, prompt communication, and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently while keeping the Controller informed.

- Full-time availability during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Philippine CPA credential.

- Previous experience as a Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accountant, or in a comparable accounting role.

- Experience supporting organizations in healthcare, education, or both.

- Intuit QuickBooks certification.

- Experience reconciling data between accounting, billing, and operational systems.

- Experience improving accounting procedures and internal controls.



## What We Offer



- Full-time remote work.

- Salary growth opportunities based on performance and client satisfaction.

- Direct collaboration with the Controller.

- Ownership of meaningful accounting responsibilities.

- The opportunity to contribute to financial reporting and accounting process improvements.



## Please Read Before Applying



This position requires practical accounting experience and the ability to take ownership of work through completion.



You should be comfortable explaining how you prepared account reconciliations, determined appropriate journal entries, investigated accounting errors, and supported month-end close. You should also know when to resolve an issue independently and when to bring it to the Controller with supporting details.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical accounting assessment covering reconciliations, journal entries, and discrepancy analysis.



## How to Apply

1. Your resume and OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

2. Your years of accounting experience, including experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.

3. Your experience with **QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop**, including the work you personally performed in each.

4. A brief description of your month-end close responsibilities, including reconciliations, journal entries, and reports you prepared.

5. One example of an accounting discrepancy you investigated, the steps you took, and how it was resolved.

6. Your experience supporting a Controller or accounting leader and the responsibilities you owned independently.

7. Any healthcare or education accounting experience and relevant credentials.

8. Your availability during U.S. Eastern business hours and earliest start date.



Please do not include confidential information from current or former employers.



## Work Requirements



- Philippines-based candidate.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a suitable home workspace.

- Consistent full-time availability and responsiveness during agreed working hours.



We are looking for an accounting professional who brings accuracy, initiative, and sound judgment, and whom the Controller can rely on to get the work completed thoroughly and on time.

title: Experienced Amazon FBA Item sourcer
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant



We are looking for a skilled and experienced Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant to join our team. The primary responsibility of this role is to research and identify profitable products for Amazon FBA through online arbitrage and online wholesalers to provide leads. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Amazon FBA, product research tools, and profit analysis, with a proven ability to find products that meet specific profitability criteria.



## Responsibilities



- Research online retailers and e-commerce websites/wholesalers to identify profitable products to resell on Amazon.

- Identify products with strong demand, competitive pricing, and consistent sales history.

- Analyze Amazon listings, Buy Box prices, sales rank, competition, and price history using tools such as Keepa and SellerAmp.

- Calculate potential net profit, ROI, Amazon fees, and shipping costs for each product.

- Find sourcing opportunities that meet our minimum profitability requirements.

- Verify exact product matches, including UPCs, ASINs, variations, sizes, and quantities.

- Identify potential risks, including restricted brands, price fluctuations, excessive competition, and low sales velocity.

- Compile organized sourcing spreadsheets with product links, purchase prices, Amazon listing links, estimated fees, net profit, ROI, and other relevant metrics.

- Monitor price changes and product performance to identify new opportunities and replenishable products.



## Requirements

When submitting your application write the word RED at the end so I know you read my job listing!

- Previous experience with Amazon FBA online arbitrage or retail arbitrage product sourcing.

- Proficiency with Keepa, SellerAmp, or similar Amazon product research tools.

- Strong understanding of Amazon FBA fees, ROI calculations, sales rank, Buy Box pricing, and product restrictions.

- Ability to identify profitable products using accurate data rather than relying solely on price differences.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to research multiple retailers and wholesalers and identify competitive sourcing opportunities.

- Excellent organizational skills and proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver quality results.



## Important Details



- This position focuses exclusively on **finding profitable products to resell on Amazon FBA through online arbitrage and retail arbitrage**.

- Wholesale account acquisition, distributor outreach, and wholesale account management are not part of this role.

- Candidates must provide accurate calculations and verifiable sourcing links for every recommended product.

- Product recommendations must account for Amazon fees, sourcing costs, shipping, competition, and potential price fluctuations.

- Candidates should prioritize products with consistent demand, healthy profit margins, and manageable competition.



## How to Apply



Please provide a brief overview of your Amazon FBA product sourcing experience, the tools you use and if they must be provided too you, and examples of profitable fba products you have sourced. Include your typical ROI, minimum net profit per unit, and sales per month and experience identifying replenishable products. Applicants to submit 3–5 sample products with retailer links, Amazon ASINs, purchase costs, current selling prices, estimated FBA fees, net profit, ROI, and Keepa history.

We are looking for someone who can consistently identify legitimate, data-backed sourcing opportunities that help our business grow. 



## Flexible Schedule & Growth Opportunities



We offer a flexible work schedule, allowing you to work during hours that best suit your local time zone, provided deadlines are met and communication remains consistent.



We value quality work, consistency, and long-term potential. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and the ability to consistently identify profitable sourcing opportunities may be considered for full-time positions as the business grows. Competitive pay increases and additional opportunities for advancement will be based on work quality, results, and overall contribution to the team.

• 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Kinetic text with sound effects, simple diagrams and icons, zooms and highlights on the screen recordings, and B-roll or images that illustrate each point, all matching our tone and brand.

• 𝗠𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗰: Choose and cut music that matches the mood and narrative of the story. We want people to feel something and come away motivated to take action in their business.

• 𝗦𝗵𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗥𝗲𝗲𝗹𝘀: Choose which moments work as Shorts and Reels, then give each one a new hook, vertical crop and captions. If an idea would work better filmed on its own, suggest it and I'll record it.

• 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗼𝗺: Pitch your own concepts and hooks, and try new formats and editing styles. If you think something will work better, we want to hear it!



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴:

• Experience editing talking-head YouTube videos, with examples you can share.

• Competence in Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software.

• A storyteller's eye. You can find the story in the raw footage and keep people watching to the end.

• Clean finishing: clear speech, consistent audio levels, balanced colour and captions that are easy to read.

• Good English. You ask questions early, give honest time estimates and warn us about delays as soon as you see them coming.

• Reliability, attention to detail and the ability to deliver to strict deadlines.



𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀:

After Effects for motion graphics, Photoshop and thumbnail design, or using AI to speed up your editing and visualise business ideas.



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀:

We'll agree each project's fee, deadline and deliverables before work begins. You'll get a clear brief for every video and all my feedback in one timecoded list.



• 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Remote, from home

• 𝗔𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Freelance, video by video

• 𝗔𝘃𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆: Online between 10am and 12pm GMT, with the rest of your hours flexible

• 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗽: A strong, stable internet connection, a computer that can handle long-form edits and motion graphics, and a backup plan for power or internet outages



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆:

If you wish to be considered as a serious candidate then send us a covering letter to support your application :)



𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧: in your cover letter please tell us what your favourite YouTube channel is :) (it's how we can tell you've read the job description!).



The next stage of the process involves answering a few short questions so that we can better understand you and if successful you may be required to complete a piece of sample work so that we can accurately judge your editing skills and abilities.

title: US HR Generalist
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized HR Generalist to support day-to-day human resources operations and ensure employee information, documentation, certifications, and HR-related tasks are kept accurate and up to date.



The HR Generalist will be responsible for monitoring employee tracking systems, following up on outstanding requirements, maintaining employee records, assisting with HR documentation, and responding to employee and management HR-related matters. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple HR tasks and deadlines.



Key Responsibilities:

• Monitor employee tracking systems and regularly review records for outstanding or incomplete items.

• Follow up with employees and relevant managers regarding pending HR requirements, documentation, and action items.

• Monitor and track required employee certifications, including ServSafe, and ensure certifications remain current.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of employee certifications, expiration dates, and compliance requirements.

• Assist with employee documentation, onboarding paperwork, forms, and other general HR administrative tasks.

• Maintain organized and accurate employee files and HR records.

• Respond to employee and management inquiries regarding HR-related matters and ensure appropriate follow-up.

• Track open HR issues and coordinate with the appropriate parties to ensure timely resolution.

• Maintain HR trackers, spreadsheets, databases, and other systems used to monitor employee information and requirements.

• Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring all required documentation and checklist items are completed.

• Support the HR team with various administrative and operational tasks as needed.

• Ensure employee information is handled accurately and confidentially.

• Identify missing, outdated, or inconsistent employee information and take appropriate steps to resolve discrepancies.

• Prepare basic HR reports, status updates, and tracking summaries when needed.



Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

• Proven experience as an HR Generalist or in a similar HR role for a U.S.-based company.

• Experience in employee relations, onboarding, benefits administration, and HR compliance.

• Experience in US employee onboarding 

• Familiarity with U.S. payroll processes, HRIS platforms, employee tracking systems, or other HR software is an advantage.

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and employee requirements.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel or Google Sheets.

• Ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.

• Proactive approach to identifying and following up on outstanding tasks.



How to apply?

1. Tell us why you are the best fit for the role, your experience as an HR Generalist for US Based companies.

2. Please send us an accessible link of your updated CV / Resume.

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services
description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities:

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience



Requirements:

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools



What We're Looking For:

We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



Tell us about your previous sales experience.

What products or services have you sold?

Have you sold home services or worked with homeowners before?

Were the leads inbound, outbound, or both?

What were your typical sales targets or results?

Give us an example of how you would respond to a customer who says, "Your price is too high. I need to think about it."

Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Please speak naturally. We are using the video primarily to evaluate your communication skills, English, confidence, and sales ability, not your video production skills.



How to Apply



Send us:

Your resume

Your video introduction

A short description of your most relevant sales experience

The types of products or services you have sold

Any sales numbers, close rates, quotas, or other performance metrics you can share



Again, sales experience and the video introduction are mandatory. Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Shopify Merchant Outreach & Business Development VA
description:
Shopify Merchant Outreach & Business Development VA



About JST Fulfill



JST Fulfill is a China-based sourcing and order fulfillment company. We support ecommerce businesses with product sourcing, quality control, order fulfillment and one-piece dropshipping.



Website:





About the Role



We are looking for a part-time Business Development VA who can independently research, contact and qualify established Shopify and DTC merchants.



This is not a simple lead-list-building or mass-messaging position.



Your responsibility is to find suitable merchants through legitimate public sources, contact the relevant decision-maker, manage the initial conversation and follow-ups, confirm a genuine business need, and bring the merchant and JST Fulfill into the same conversation.



You do not need to close the sale or provide detailed quotations. JST will handle pricing, service terms, shipping discussions, negotiations and closing.



Target Prospects



The primary target is an established Shopify or DTC merchant that:



• Operates an active online store.

• Already receives genuine customer orders.

• Sells physical products.

• May need China sourcing, product development, QC, fulfillment or one-piece dropshipping.

• Can be contacted through the owner, founder, ecommerce manager, operations manager or another relevant decision-maker.



You may also identify relevant ecommerce agencies, Shopify consultants or other service providers that already work with established Shopify merchants. However, general partnership lists or unverified contacts do not count as Qualified Inquiries.



Key Responsibilities



• Independently research suitable Shopify and DTC merchants.

• Use LinkedIn, Google,
,
, ecommerce communities, agency directories and other legitimate public sources.

• Identify and contact the correct decision-maker.

• Review the merchant’s store, product category and public business information before contacting them.

• Write concise and personalized outreach messages.

• Manage the initial conversation and reasonable follow-ups.

• Confirm whether the merchant has a genuine current sourcing, QC, fulfillment or dropshipping need.

• Obtain permission before introducing the merchant to JST.

• Bring the merchant and JST into the same WhatsApp,
, LinkedIn or other appropriate conversation.

• Provide JST with a short summary of the merchant’s business and confirmed requirements.

• Maintain accurate records of active conversations, follow-ups and introductions.



The merchant does not need to contact JST independently. You may create a WhatsApp group, make an
 introduction, open a LinkedIn conversation, arrange a call or use another appropriate method that brings the merchant and JST together.



What Counts as a Qualified Inquiry



A Qualified Inquiry must satisfy all of the following conditions:



1. The prospect operates an active Shopify or DTC business and already has genuine customer orders.

2. You are communicating with the owner, founder, ecommerce manager, operations manager or another relevant decision-maker.

3. The prospect confirms a current and specific sourcing, QC, fulfillment or dropshipping need.

4. The prospect provides enough information for JST to continue the discussion, such as a product link, product image, store link, specification, destination market or a clear description of the problem.

5. The prospect agrees to join a shared conversation with JST.



The prospect may join through WhatsApp,
, LinkedIn, an online meeting or another suitable channel.



What Does Not Count



The following do not count as Qualified Inquiries:



• Contact lists or scraped leads.

• Contact details without an active conversation.

• Generic replies such as “send me more information.”

• A meeting without a confirmed business need.

• Someone who is not a decision-maker and cannot connect us with one.

• A store that is not active or does not have genuine customer orders.

• Samples, personal orders, self-orders, test orders, cancelled orders or refunded orders.

• An existing JST customer, an existing active JST lead or a duplicate introduction.

• A prospect introduced without their knowledge or permission.



Working Method



JST will provide:



• Company and service information.

• Target prospect and qualification guidelines.

• Basic outreach positioning and prohibited claims.

• A tracking format for active conversations and Qualified Inquiries.

• Support when a prospect requires detailed service information.



JST will not provide a ready-made prospect list or guarantee access to paid prospecting tools.



You should be able to research prospects independently using legitimate public sources and professional accounts that you are authorized to use.



Do not use fake accounts, purchased private databases, unauthorized client information or misleading identities.



Professional Rules



• Represent yourself truthfully as an independent outreach or business development partner working with JST Fulfill.

• Do not claim to be the owner, employee or official representative of a merchant.

• Do not promise prices, discounts, shipping times, product availability, commissions or business results on JST’s behalf.

• Do not send spam or use deceptive outreach methods.

• Follow the rules of each communication platform.

• Protect prospect and customer information.

• Do not contact the same business repeatedly after it has declined further communication.



Compensation After Formal Appointment



This is a long-term part-time position requiring approximately 20 hours per week.



Base compensation:



USD 550–800 per month, depending on verified experience and capability.



Performance incentives:



• USD 20 for each verified Qualified Inquiry.

• USD 30 when an attributed seller completes 5 genuine customer orders through JST.

• An additional USD 70 when the same seller completes 20 genuine customer orders.

• Ongoing 2% commission on eligible settled service fees generated by sellers attributed to your work.



Base compensation is paid monthly through Wise or PayPal. Qualified Inquiry rewards, order milestone rewards and commissions are paid after verification according to JST’s attribution and settlement records.



Performance and compensation may be reviewed after 90 days. Consistently strong performers may be considered for a higher base rate. Any increase is performance-based and is not automatic.



Performance Expectations



This role is evaluated primarily by the quality of conversations and verified business results, not only by the number of messages sent.



Initial performance expectations include:



• Approximately 150–250 carefully targeted and personalized contacts per month.

• At least 2 Qualified Inquiries during the first formal month.

• An ongoing target of approximately 3–4 Qualified Inquiries per month after onboarding.

• At least 1 attributed seller progressing toward active cooperation within the first 60 days.

• Accurate tracking and professional follow-up.



Outreach volume is used as a diagnostic indicator. It does not replace the requirement to produce genuine Qualified Inquiries.



Hiring Process

title: Shopify Merchant Introduction Partner – For Experienced VAs
description:
Shopify Merchant Referral Partner – For Experienced VAs



About JST Fulfill



JST Fulfill is a China-based sourcing and order fulfillment company. We support ecommerce businesses with product sourcing, quality control, order fulfillment and one-piece dropshipping.



Website:





About This Opportunity



This is a flexible referral partnership for Virtual Assistants and ecommerce professionals who currently work, or have previously worked, directly with established Shopify or DTC merchants.



This is not a traditional VA position, a cold-outreach role or a lead-list-building job.



We understand that an experienced VA may only know a limited number of suitable Shopify merchants. You are not expected to provide new merchants every week or every month.



If a Shopify merchant you legitimately know has a genuine need for China sourcing, QC, fulfillment or one-piece dropshipping, you may introduce the merchant to JST Fulfill and earn fixed rewards based on the introduction and the merchant’s subsequent eligible-order milestones.



Even if you only know one or two suitable merchants, you may still participate.



There are no fixed working hours, no monthly referral quota and no requirement to leave your current job.



Who This Is For



This opportunity may be suitable for:



• Shopify Virtual Assistants

• Ecommerce Operations VAs

• Shopify Store Managers

• Customer Support or Order Management VAs

• Ecommerce Account Managers

• Product Listing or Product Research VAs

• Ecommerce Project Managers

• VA agency team members

• Freelancers who have worked directly with established Shopify merchants



Previous work under the exact title “Virtual Assistant” is not required. However, you should have genuine experience working directly with Shopify or DTC businesses and should be able to communicate legitimately with a store owner or another relevant decision-maker.



How It Works



1. Review JST Fulfill’s services and referral requirements.



2. When a Shopify merchant you legitimately know has a genuine sourcing, QC, fulfillment or dropshipping need, ask whether the merchant is willing to speak with JST.



3. Obtain the merchant’s permission before making the introduction.



4. Bring the merchant and JST into the same conversation.



You may:



• Create a WhatsApp group.

• Make a shared
 introduction.

• Open a LinkedIn conversation.

• Arrange an online meeting.

• Use another appropriate communication method.



The merchant does not need to contact JST independently. You may create the introduction and bring both parties together.



5. Provide a short summary of the merchant’s business and confirmed requirements.



6. JST will handle product details, quotations, pricing, shipping discussions, service terms, negotiations and closing.



You are not required to close the sale.



Referral Rewards



Each accepted merchant is registered and tracked separately.



For each attributed merchant, you can earn:



• USD 30 when JST verifies and accepts the Qualified Referral.

• An additional USD 40 when the merchant completes 50 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 80 when the merchant completes 500 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 150 when the merchant completes 1,000 Eligible Orders through JST.

• An additional USD 300 when the merchant completes 2,000 Eligible Orders through JST.



Total potential rewards for one merchant reaching 2,000 Eligible Orders:



USD 600



The rewards are cumulative. Each milestone reward is paid once for each attributed merchant.



There is no fixed working schedule, no minimum number of referrals and no requirement to provide new merchants every month.



Verified rewards are paid through Wise or PayPal.



What Counts as a Qualified Referral



A referral will count as a Qualified Referral only when all of the following conditions are satisfied:



1. The merchant operates an active Shopify or DTC store.

2. The merchant already receives genuine customer orders.

3. You are communicating with the store owner, founder, ecommerce manager, operations manager or another relevant decision-maker.

4. The merchant has a current and specific sourcing, QC, fulfillment or one-piece dropshipping need.

5. The merchant provides enough information for JST to continue the discussion, such as a store link, product link, image, specification, destination market or a clear description of the current problem.

6. The merchant agrees to communicate directly with JST.

7. You bring the merchant and JST into the same WhatsApp,
, LinkedIn, meeting or other approved conversation.

8. The merchant is not an existing JST customer, existing active JST lead or duplicate referral.



JST will confirm in writing whether the referral has been accepted and registered under your name.



The USD 30 Qualified Referral reward will be paid only after the referral has been reviewed and accepted by JST.



What Does Not Count



The following do not count as Qualified Referrals:



• Lists of Shopify stores.

• Scraped or purchased contacts.

• Contact details without an active conversation.

• Generic replies without a confirmed business need.

• Someone who is not a decision-maker.

• A merchant introduced without their permission.

• A store without genuine customer orders.

• Samples, personal orders, self-orders or artificial test orders.

• Cancelled or refunded orders.

• An existing JST customer, existing active lead or duplicate referral.

• A fabricated merchant, conversation, requirement or screenshot.



Eligible Order Definition



An Eligible Order is a genuine end-customer order submitted by the attributed merchant to JST, processed through JST and included in JST’s verified settlement records.



The following do not count as Eligible Orders:



• Test orders

• Sample orders

• Personal orders

• Self-orders

• Cancelled orders

• Refunded orders

• Fraudulent orders

• Orders placed before the merchant was registered under the referral partner



The 50-order, 500-order, 1,000-order and 2,000-order milestones are calculated separately for each attributed merchant.



Professional and Privacy Rules



• Obtain the merchant’s permission before making an introduction.

• Do not share confidential client lists, customer data, order data, passwords, store access or private business information.

• Do not contact a current or previous employer’s clients if you are not authorized to do so.

• Follow any employment, confidentiality or non-solicitation agreements that apply to you.

• Do not promise specific prices, discounts, shipping times, availability or business results on JST’s behalf.

• Do not misrepresent your relationship with the merchant or with JST.

• Do not pressure a merchant who has no genuine current need.

• Where required by your agreement or professional obligations, disclose that you may receive a referral reward.



Your professional relationship and reputation are important. Only recommend JST when the merchant has a genuine and relevant need.



Tracking and Transparency



When JST accepts a Qualified Referral:



• JST will confirm the attribution in writing.

• The merchant will be registered under your referral record.

• JST will track the merchant’s Eligible Orders.

• JST will notify you when a reward milestone is verified.

• Verified rewards will be paid according to the written referral terms.



Customer-level confidential order details may be withheld, but JST will provide sufficient information to confirm the applicable milestone and reward.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the code:



JST-REFERRAL-26



Please provide:



1. Your resume, professional profile or OnlineJobs.ph profile.



2. Brief answers to the following questions:



• What Shopify or ecommerce work are you currently doing, or what relevant work have you done during the past two years?

• What tasks did you perform directly for Shopify merchants?

• Did you communicate directly with the store owner, founder, ecommerce manager or operations manager?

• Approximately how many Shopify merchants could you legitimately contact if a relevant need arises? A reasonable range is acceptable.

• Why would these merchants recognize or trust you?



Do not provide client names, private contact information or confidential business information in your initial application.



Selection Process



JST will review your application and relevant Shopify experience.



Suitable applicants will receive the written referral terms and a short introduction to JST’s services.



After accepting the terms, you may begin making referrals whenever a legitimate opportunity arises.



There is no application fee, unpaid trial, deposit, training fee or software fee.



Your first accepted Qualified Referral will be paid according to the normal reward structure.



This is a flexible, results-based referral partnership. It is not a guaranteed monthly salary position.

In Founders Words is a LinkedIn ghostwriting agency. We write LinkedIn content for founders and executives at tech startups and scale-ups, helping them build their presence and grow their businesses.



7 reasons why you will love this job:

This is a hybrid role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will go to admin, client operations and finance, and roughly 30–40% to LinkedIn outreach. Both for the owner of In Founders Words Dan and for clients. Your role will grow over time and you will get additional responsibilities.



Admin, operations & finance (60–70%):

title: CNC Machine Shops Needed – Real Production Machining Data (Fusion 360 CAM)
description:
We are looking for CNC machine shops and authorized manufacturing data suppliers who can provide original files from real, previously completed 3-axis CNC milling jobs using Autodesk Fusion 360 CAM.

All parts must have been physically machined in actual production. We are not looking for newly created designs, simulated CAM projects, or regenerated G-code.



Required Files per Part

Please refer to the attached sample package.

1. 3D Model: Original part model (STEP or equivalent).

2. Fusion 360 CAM File: Original .f3d file containing the model, machining setups, tools, and toolpaths.

3. Actual Machine-Run G-code: Original CNC programs used during production, covering every setup or clamping operation.

4. 2D Production Drawing: Original drawing with dimensions and tolerances (PDF or DWG).

5. Part Information: Material, machine make/model, controller, shop location, and relevant production details.



Data Ownership & Authorization

All files must come from genuine, completed production jobs.

The machine shop must own the files or have explicit permission from the rights holder to share and license them.

We do not accept confidential, NDA-restricted, export-controlled, or unauthorized customer files.

Shop and customer information will be handled under the agreed confidentiality and data-use terms.



Paid Pilot & Ongoing Opportunities

- Initial Pilot: 5 real CNC-machined parts from the same machine shop.

- Pilot Payment: $100 total ($20 per QC-approved part).

Quality Review: Files must be complete, original, consistent, and verified against our requirements.

- Ongoing Work: Additional batches of approximately 20 parts, depending on data availability and successful QC approval.



We are interested in long-term partnerships with reliable CNC machine shops and authorized suppliers.



Who Should Apply?

- CNC machine shop owners or managers

- CNC production teams using Fusion 360 CAM

- Authorized representatives with access to genuine archived manufacturing data

- Manufacturing data suppliers working directly with verified CNC shops



How to Apply

Please briefly confirm:

1. Do you have access to real, previously manufactured 3-axis CNC milling jobs using Fusion 360 CAM?

2. Can you provide the original CAM files, production drawings, and actual machine-run G-code?

3. Do you own these files or have authorization to share them?

4. Can you supply 5 qualifying parts from the same shop for the initial paid pilot?



Important: This is a manufacturing data sourcing project, not a CAD design or CNC programming job

It is an innovative, highly functional eco-friendly product that solves a universal daily problem: keeping bread fresh for significantly longer.
