PECTG is a restoration, remodeling, roofing, and custom homebuilding company in Georgia, operating since 1998, with a roofing division, Klaus Roofing Systems (KRS). This is a behind the scenes systems role. You will not contact customers.



Schedule, Pay, and Reporting

Item Detail

Type Remote, Philippines based contractor

Hours Part time (20 hrs/week) to start, with a path to full time

Schedule At least 4 hrs/day overlapping US Eastern business hours (night shift PH time)

Pay $6 to $9 USD/hr based on experience 

Reports to Phil Traylor, Owner

Working sessions 3 live screen share sessions/week for days 1 to 60, then 2/week

Written update Every Friday: done, next, decisions needed



Responsibilities

1. SOPs and team adoption (top priority). Write short, role based HubSpot guides for each of our 6 users (owner, finance, scheduling, production, mitigation, sales): what they enter, when, and which fields are required. Maintain them as the system changes.

2. Pipeline design and build. Build deal pipelines for each service line: water mitigation, fire and smoke, mold, reconstruction and remodeling, KRS roofing, custom homebuilding. Set up past customer and nurture tracking using lifecycle stages and segments.

3. Database cleanup and hygiene. Dedupe, standardize, and complete contact, company, and deal records. Set naming rules and required fields, and keep them enforced.

4. Dashboards and reporting. Build a weekly dashboard from native HubSpot data and a monthly scorecard using data we provide by CSV (social media, QuickBooks).

5. Ongoing administration. Manage properties, views, workflows, and user permissions in Sales Hub Professional and Service Hub Professional.



Required Competencies

Must have

• 5+ years of hands on HubSpot administration, including Professional tier accounts

• Current HubSpot Academy certifications: Sales Hub Software, Service Hub Software, and Reporting

• Pipeline and deal stage design across multiple business lines

• Custom properties, workflows, saved views, and user permissions

• Data hygiene: deduping, CSV import mapping, naming standards, required fields

• Custom reports and dashboards that a busy owner can read in 2 minutes

• Clear written English for SOPs a field team will actually follow

• Self direction: audits, recommends, and builds without hand holding

• Discretion with homeowner and insurance claim data

Nice to have

• Experience with construction, home services, or restoration companies

• Experience documenting systems built by outside consultants



Interview test question: How would you track past customers and nurture contacts in HubSpot? (Strong answer: lifecycle stages and segments, not deal pipelines.)

30/60/90 Day Objectives

SOPs are the headline deliverable, written alongside pipeline design so they never need a rewrite.

Phase Objectives Done when

Days 1 to 30: Audit and design Map every pipeline, property, workflow, integration, and consultant build. Draft the pipeline design and SOP outline per role. Audit report and change log delivered; pipeline design and SOP outline approved by Phil

Days 31 to 60: Build and train Build all service line pipelines and nurture segments. Finalize role based SOPs. Train all 6 users. Pipelines live; 6 SOPs published; every user trained and signed off

Days 61 to 90: Clean and report Clean the database to the new standards. Build the weekly dashboard and monthly scorecard. Data quality targets met; dashboard reviewed with Phil weekly

KPIs

Targets are proposed starting points; Phil sets the final numbers after the day 30 audit.

KPI Target Measured

SOP adoption: users following their SOP in spot checks 90%+ Monthly

Duplicate contact rate Under 2% Monthly

Required fields complete on open deals 95%+ Weekly

Deals with lead source and referral partner filled 100% of new deals Weekly

Stale deals (no activity 14+ days) flagged to owner 100% Weekly

Weekly dashboard delivered on time Every Monday Weekly

Monthly scorecard delivered By the 5th Monthly

Admin request turnaround Within 1 business day Weekly

Breaks to existing integrations or consultant builds Zero Ongoing

Dashboard scope. Weekly (native HubSpot): leads by source, outbound and sales activity, sales results and close rate by pipeline, referral tracking. Monthly (imported CSV): social media performance, impressions, engagement, marketing ROI, revenue per employee, referral fees paid.

Guardrails

The rule: never break an existing connection or a consultant's work.

• Before changing anything, document what exists: integrations, workflows, properties, and who built them

• Keep a written change log of every change: what, why, date, and how to undo it

• Export a backup before any bulk edit, import, merge, or delete

• Test bulk changes on a small batch first

• Never delete or edit consultant built workflows, properties, or integrations without Phil's written approval

• Activating a new workflow requires Phil's approval

• Routine cleanup within approved standards can proceed without sign off



Hiring Process

1. Application. Resume, HubSpot certification links, and a short note on the most complex HubSpot account you have administered.

2. Screening call (30 min). English, availability for Eastern hours, and the past customer and nurture test question.

3. Paid live test (60 to 90 min, paid at the posted rate). Over screen share with Phil watching, the candidate cleans a messy sample contact list: dedupe, standardize, fix fields, and explain their logic out loud.

4. Final interview with Phil. Walk through how they would run days 1 to 30 at PECTG.

5. Offer and 30 day trial with a review against the day 30 objectives.

Scoring the live test: accuracy, logic explained clearly, backup taken before changes, and questions asked before touching anything.

Market reference: Flexiwork HubSpot VA, OnlineJobs.ph HubSpot VA

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: EXPERIENCED EDITOR,  LONG-TERM FREELANCE
description:

OUR CONTENT

Initial work involves removing filler words, mistakes, unnecessary pauses, and distracting breaths while preserving natural speech.



Detailed instructions and examples are provided for our specific workflow.



• 1 video: 24-hour turnaround

• 2 videos: 48-hour turnaround



Assignments are communicated in advance, typically midweek. Deadlines begin when complete project files are provided.



PAYMENT & QUALITY STANDARDS



Paid trial: $20 for one 20–30-minute video.



Following a successful trial, audio-only editing is paid according to the accuracy of the original submission:



• 0–4 revision notes: $40 per video

• 5–20 revision notes: $30 per video

• 21+ revision notes: $20 per video



ASSIGNMENT & PAYMENT PROCESS



1. Submit: Review your work before delivery. Submit an invoice for the $20 base payment.



2. Review: We evaluate your submission within 2–4 calendar days and identify editing errors.



3. Improve: You'll receive your original edit alongside our finalized version. Study the differences,
 a brief summary of what you learned, and invoice for any remaining quality bonus based on feedback marks.



4. Final payment: The quality bonus is paid after your review acknowledgment, based on the original submission's accuracy.



LATE DELIVERY DEDUCTIONS (BONUSES ONLY)



• Up to 5 hours late: $5 deduction

• 12 hours late: $10 deduction

• Over 24 hours late: No bonus; $20 base only



Revision notes count errors or missed instructions, not new creative requests. Repeated mistakes, missed deadlines, or failure to demonstrate improvement may result in ending the working relationship. We do not accommodate repeated mistakes.



LONG-TERM GROWTH



As quality and independence improve, responsibilities may expand to include:



• Sound effects, GIFs, text, and humor

• Animations, visuals, and creative storytelling

• Complete video editing from start to finish

• Thumbnail/cover art creation

• Shorts, scriptwriting, and other creative projects



EARNING POTENTIAL

• Up to $150 per two-video assignment for complete video editing with minimal revisions.

• Up to $250 per weekly assignment (approximately $1,000 per month) with additional production responsibilities as trust grows.



Advancement depends on consistent quality, reliability, and independence.



TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL FOUR QUESTIONS



1. Reliability: Provide verifiable evidence of recurring editing work, including client relationship duration and delivery history. How will your current schedule accommodate our 24–48-hour deadlines now and over the next 1–2 years? The more detail, the better.



2. English: Confirm your C2 or native/bilingual proficiency and provide supporting evidence.



3. Experience: Share examples of podcast or spoken-audio editing you've personally completed, specifying your responsibilities and software used.



4. Content compatibility: Explain your familiarity with our content genres and why you're comfortable working with them regularly, including contributing creative ideas.



Applications missing the requested information or mandatory qualifications will not receive a response.



START DATE & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



The role begins January 1, 2027. We are taking our time to find the right person and expect thoughtful, detailed applications that demonstrate genuine interest and attention to instructions. (P.s. We can tell if you used AI to write your response, we are looking for true thoughtful personality)

title: Virtual Assistant: End-to-End Book Promotion (One-Time Project)
description:
## Project



I am the author of *Who Am I Without the Badge?*, a nonfiction book about career identity, professional transitions, leadership, and personal growth.



**Amazon book link:**



I am looking for a proactive virtual assistant who can independently execute a low-cost, hands-off book-promotion campaign on my behalf. This is not just a research assignment. I want someone who can identify opportunities, prepare promotional materials, carry out approved activities, and document the results.



My priority is **zero-cost promotion first**. I am open to using AI tools to support research and content creation, provided all information is accurate, factual, and checked before publication.



## Responsibilities and deliverables



### 1. Identify relevant promotional opportunities



Find at least 20 legitimate opportunities to promote the book to English-speaking audiences interested in career development, leadership, personal growth, professional identity, and career transitions.



Include relevant:

- Book-promotion newsletters and websites.

- Book bloggers and reviewers.

- Podcasts and interview opportunities.

- Social media communities and creators.

- Career-development and leadership communities.

- Author groups, professional networks, and relevant online communities.

- Free directories, promotional submissions, and opportunities for guest articles.



Prioritize opportunities that can reach readers in the US, UK, Canada, and other relevant English-speaking markets.



### 2. Execute a zero-cost promotional campaign



Do not stop at creating a spreadsheet. Take action on the strongest opportunities.



- Submit the book to suitable free promotional directories and websites where permitted.

- Prepare and publish approved social media posts or community contributions where access and community rules allow.

- Contact relevant bloggers, podcasters, newsletter operators, and creators using personalized outreach.

- Identify opportunities for interviews, guest articles, author features, and legitimate recommendations.

- Prepare promotional copy, short descriptions, and other materials needed to make execution efficient.

- Use the Amazon book link consistently and verify that submitted links work.



Where an account, permission, author approval, or access is required, explain what is needed rather than pretending the task is complete.



### 3. Use AI intelligently and accurately



AI tools may be used for research, drafting, personalization, and organizing the campaign.



All claims about the book, author, audience, and promotional opportunities must be fact-checked. Do not invent credentials, testimonials, reviews, audience figures, or campaign results.



I can provide the book summary and other source materials needed to ensure the promotional copy accurately represents the book.



### 4. Maintain a live campaign tracker



Deliver a Google Sheet or Excel spreadsheet containing:



- Provider or opportunity name.

- Website and working submission/contact link.

- Country and audience profile.

- Why the opportunity fits this book.

- Cost, with free opportunities clearly identified.

- Eligibility and submission requirements.

- Action taken and date.

- Current status and any response received.

- Evidence of execution, including published URLs or screenshots.

- Next action and any assistance required from me.



Clearly distinguish completed activities from planned activities and pending responses.



### 5. Provide a final report



At the end of the project, provide:



- The 20 or more researched opportunities.

- A prioritized list of the five strongest opportunities.

- The activities actually completed.

- Direct links and screenshots proving execution where available.

- Replies received and outstanding follow-ups.

- A concise recommendation for the next steps based on the results.



## Strict operating rules



- Zero promotional spend by default.

- Do not purchase placements, advertisements, subscriptions, or services.

- Do not contact providers, publish content, or make commitments that require my approval until I have approved the relevant activity.

- You may independently execute free, permitted activities within the agreed scope once I have approved the campaign approach.

- No fake reviews, paid customer reviews, artificial engagement, manipulated purchases, guaranteed sales claims, or misleading promotion practices.

- Respect each platform's rules, privacy requirements, and anti-spam policies.

- Do not request my Amazon KDP password or other sensitive account credentials.

- Never claim an activity was completed without verifiable evidence.



## Budget and engagement



This is a one-time, fixed-price project with a maximum fee of $15 for the initial assignment.



There is no ongoing retainer. No additional fees or promotional expenditure are authorized without my written approval.



## Ideal candidate



You have strong written English, initiative, sound research skills, and experience in book marketing, creator outreach, digital promotion, or online research.



You are resourceful, organized, comfortable using AI tools responsibly, and able to execute work independently rather than simply provide recommendations.



Please explain briefly how you would approach the first seven days of this project and provide one example of similar work you have completed.

title: Amazon Catalog & Compliance Specialist (EU + US Marketplaces)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Owns catalog quality and product compliance for BTL Diffusion's baby and children's product brands across 130 SKUs in 5 marketplaces (US, FR, DE, ES, IT). Keeps every listing accurate, complete, compliant with US and EU product safety rules (including GPSR), and fully localized. Runs the daily and weekly Seller Central routines that keep the account healthy.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Catalog Quality

• Fix main and secondary images, and fill gaps in A+ Content coverage.

• Correct variation-family splits so reviews and ratings consolidate properly.

• Fix category nodes, titles, and bullet points.

• Fix Brand Store and listing detail issues, including features, specifications, and item details.

• Review Catalog Signals daily and act on flagged issues.

• Clear suppressed, stranded, and inactive listings.



Compliance

• Keep all EU listings (France, Germany, Italy, and Spain) GPSR-compliant: manufacturer details, EU Responsible Person details, safety warnings, and instructions in each local language.

• Respond to Amazon product safety requests in all 5 marketplaces, including test reports, product photos, manuals, and Children's Product Certificates (CPC) for the US.

• Keep compliance documents current in the shared compliance folder, following the Compliance SOP.

• Check Account Health daily and resolve policy warnings before they affect selling status.

• Follow Seller Support cases through to resolution, and track and report competitor policy violations.



EU Localization

• Produce FR/DE/ES/IT listing copy through the localization workflow (Amazon auto-translate, Brand Analytics, Helium 10, and approved AI tools).

• Localize existing A+ Content into all EU marketplace languages.

• QA all machine-translated copy before publishing, including safety warnings.



Routine & Ad Hoc

• Daily: Voice of the Customer (VoC) and AWD Inventory snapshots

• Weekly: Data Quality Signals reports (SB, AWD, FBA), updated in the team's reports tracker

• Ad hoc requests from the Operations team



REQUIREMENTS

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central listings across multiple marketplaces (more is a strong plus)

• Working knowledge of variation setup, category nodes, flat files, and bulk listing uploads

• Experience handling Amazon product safety and compliance document requests

• Working knowledge of GPSR requirements for EU listings

• Experience resolving Account Health issues, policy violations, and Seller Support cases

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

• Strong attention to detail for catalog QA work



HOW YOU WORK

• Builder mentality: sets up processes and fixes from scratch

• Detail-first: catches errors before they go live

• Follows Seller Support cases through until they're resolved

• To show you've read this post, use the word "Platypus" in the first sentence of your cover letter.

• Keeps routines on schedule without reminders

• Documents fixes so the team can repeat them



SUCCESS IN FIRST 6 MONTHS

• Catalog fully cleaned: no suppressed or stranded listings, and variation families consolidated

• GPSR information complete on all EU listings

• EU localization live and QA'd, including A+ Content in all EU languages

• Account Health in good standing with no unresolved violations

• Daily and weekly report routines running on schedule, with no missed reports

• Competitor policy violations tracked and reported monthly



WORK SETUP

• Remote, with company-provided equipment

• Schedule: 12pm–9pm MANILA time



HOW TO APPLY

Make sure your OnlineJobs.ph profile includes your updated resume and work history. In your application message, include:



1. Cover letter (max 250 words): Tell us about the hardest Amazon catalog or compliance problem you've solved: what was wrong, what you tried first, what worked, and what you'd do differently.



2. Your answers to these questions:



   Q1: GPSR requires an EU Responsible Person on every listing, including the US. How would you set this up for our US listings?



   Q2: A listing is suppressed in Germany. What's wrong with this fix plan, and what would you do instead?

   a. Open a Seller Support case right away.

   b. If still suppressed, delete and relist.

   c. Upload the US safety documents. They work in all marketplaces.

   d. Use a lifestyle photo as the main image.



Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.

**5. Report the evidence**

Provide:

- The completed spreadsheet

- A copy or screenshot of each of the 20 messages sent, including recipient and date

- Evidence of any replies or confirmed placements

- A short final report showing what was completed and what needs follow-up



## Rules



- Use free promotional opportunities only.

- Do not purchase advertising, subscriptions, placements, or services.

- Do not buy reviews, arrange fake reviews, or promise positive reviews in exchange for payment.

- Do not use bots, fake engagement, spam lists, or misleading claims.

- Do not publish content or spend money without permission.

- Do not promise sales or guaranteed placements; focus on genuine outreach and verifiable work.

- Do not request access to my Amazon account or ask for passwords.

- Follow each website's submission rules and respect requests not to be contacted again.



## How to apply



Please start your application with **BOOK PROMOTION** so I know you have read the full description.



Briefly tell me about any previous book promotion, blogger outreach, podcast outreach, or
 research work you have done. If possible, include one example of a spreadsheet or outreach campaign you have completed.



I value reliability, clear communication, and proof of work over big promises.

title: COLD OUTBOUND SETTER
description:
COLD OUTBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER – Full Time (US Real Estate Market)



ABOUT US

We are a growing digital marketing and client acquisition agency helping real estate agents and teams across the United States generate more buyer and seller leads. We run Meta ads, GoHighLevel (GHL) automations and AI-powered lead qualification for our clients.



We are looking for a confident, driven Cold Outbound Setter to book qualified sales appointments with US real estate agents, team leaders and brokers. This is a long-term, full-time role for the right person.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make cold outbound calls to real estate agents, team leads and brokers across the US

- Send cold outreach messages (SMS,
, social DMs) and follow up consistently

- Qualify prospects using our script and criteria (production level, team size, current lead sources, budget)

- Book qualified discovery calls into the calendar

- Handle objections professionally (e.g. "I get leads from Zillow", "I've tried ads before", "I'm too busy")

- Log every call, note and pipeline update inside GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Follow up with no-shows and warm leads until they book or say no

- Hit daily activity targets (dials, conversations, appointments set)

- Report your numbers daily and share feedback on what's working



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven previous sales experience (cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR/BDR role) – REQUIRED

- Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, confident phone voice and a neutral accent

- Comfortable with rejection and making high volumes of calls daily

- Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Reliable internet connection, quiet work space and a good-quality headset

- Available to work US business hours (Eastern to Pacific time zones – night shift in the Philippines)



PREFERRED (BIG PLUS)

- Previous experience using GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Experience in the US real estate industry (ISA, cold calling for agents, appointment setting for realtors)

- Experience selling B2B to business owners or sales professionals

- Understanding of US real estate terms (listings, buyers/sellers, brokerages, GCI, FSBO, expireds)

- Familiarity with dialers and CRM pipelines



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position (40 hours per week)

- $3–$5 USD per hour, based on experience and performance

- Opportunity for pay increases as you hit and exceed targets

- Training on our offer, scripts and systems

- A chance to grow with a fast-growing international agency



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following:

1. Start your application with the words "READY TO DIAL" so we know you read the full post

2. A short summary of your previous sales/appointment setting experience (companies, what you sold, your results – e.g. appointments booked per week)

3. Whether you have used GoHighLevel and how long

4. Any US real estate experience you have

5. Confirmation that you can work US business hours

6. A link to a 1–2 minute voice recording of you doing a mock cold call introduction to a US real estate agent (Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar)



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.
